Varjo’s VR and XR solutions are already being used to train astronauts, design vehicles, and support many more professional use cases across the world’s leading companies. Our multicultural team consists of talents from all around the world, and our daily working language is English. We believe in the power of diversity – where different experiences, backgrounds, and ideas drive innovation and results. **Job Description** Varjo is seeking a **Sales Development Representative** to join our sales team on a **fixed-term** basis from August 2024 to March 2025. As a Sales Development Representative, you will be helping organizations adopt the world’s most advanced virtual and mixed reality products for industrial use. You will act as a link between our sales and marketing teams and help us acquire new business by researching, contacting, and qualifying our inbound leads, as well as proactively seeking new opportunities by contacting and developing relationships with potential international customers who are not familiar with our company. The company is in a high-growth mode right now, and we are looking for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment. We hope you are curious by nature, analytical, enjoy solving problems, and have a self-starting entrepreneurial mindset. As this is an entry-level role, your mindset and attitude are what matter most to us. **What You’ll Be Doing** - Systematically qualify inbound leads at the initial stages of the sales funnel. - Contact potential clients through phone, email, and LinkedIn. - Engage with prospective customers by effectively communicating the value proposition of Varjo’s products, qualifying their fit, and raising their interest while handling objections. - Schedule high-value, in-person and online meetings with qualified prospective customers for Account Executives. - Research and identify new outbound business opportunities by prospecting and researching the right contacts at targeted companies. - Reach out to attendees of industry tradeshows and conferences both before and after the events. - Take ownership of the top-of-the-funnel activities and improve our processes, including CRM data management. **Our Expectations** - Bachelor’s degree or late-stage Master’s studies in business or technology. - It is an entry level job and 1+ year of sales experience or experience in any customer-facing role would be sufficient. - Experience working with CRM and marketing automation tools. - Interest and can-do attitude in engaging with prospects and customers. - Passion for working in a fast-paced and international start-up environment and in engaging with international customers. - Excellent interpersonal, presentation, verbal, and written communication skills in English. **By Joining Us, You’ll Get** - The possibility to see into the future of computing by taking part in creating the new state of the art in virtual and mixed reality products and experiences. - A startup culture with minimal bureaucracy and maximum opportunity for you to take charge of your work. - Flexible working conditions, competitive salary for entry level job, and great benefits. - An international working environment with tons of opportunities to learn and grow with the company. - The possibility to select the tools and methods you want to use to do your job effectively. - Premium employee medical coverage with life insurance and disability benefits. - Office located right in the middle of downtown Helsinki. Ready to jump into the exciting world of VR/XR? Apply now by submitting your CV and Cover Letter. **Recruitment Process** We will begin interviews as soon as applications are received. The process will consist of up to three interview stages. This role will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found.

description: **Role Overview** We are looking for a Systems Software Engineer to work on the software that runs on our embedded devices - from board bring-up and low-level driver work through to complete, deployable applications. A significant part of the role is integration: bringing multiple peripherals and sensors into a single system and making them work together reliably. That means writing the interface layers, getting the data flowing correctly and on time, and then proving the whole thing holds up under real operating conditions. The role suits an engineer who is comfortable close to the hardware, who reads a datasheet before writing code, and who enjoys the point where software, electronics and sensors meet. **Key Responsibilities** - Develop and bring up complete embedded system applications, from initial board bring-up to deployed software. - Integrate multiple peripherals and sensors into a working system — writing interface and driver-level code, and validating behaviour against hardware. - Implement communication over standard interfaces and buses (I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, USB, Ethernet and similar), including protocol handling, framing and error recovery. - Build reliable data paths between subsystems, handling timing, buffering, synchronisation and throughput constraints. - Write multi-threaded and concurrent code, with careful attention to synchronisation, shared state and real-time behaviour. - Optimise software for speed, memory footprint and deterministic performance across target platforms. - Diagnose and fix bugs, race conditions and performance bottlenecks, including issues that only appear on real hardware. - Work with image and video data paths where required — capture, buffering and processing. - Collaborate with hardware, firmware, algorithms and systems teams to define, design and ship new features. - Maintain high coding standards, with clean, reviewable and testable code. - Travel to client sites as needed to support integration, commissioning and field debugging. **Qualifications** - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering or a related technical field. - Proven professional experience in C and C++, particularly in embedded or systems-level software. - Strong background in embedded application and firmware development, with examples of prior work. - Practical experience integrating peripherals and sensors, and working directly from datasheets and interface specifications. - Solid understanding of multi-threading and concurrent programming, and the failure modes that come with them. - Comfortable working in Linux, including cross-compilation and building for embedded targets. - Strong debugging instincts and analytical skills, especially where the problem sits between software and hardware. - Clear communication, including the ability to explain technical detail to non-technical stakeholders. - Willingness and ability to travel for client engagements. **Preferred Skills** - Experience with image processing, video pipelines or camera interfaces. - Familiarity with device drivers, kernel-space development or RTOS environments. - Working knowledge of Python for test, automation and analysis tooling. - Version control with Git, and familiarity with modern build systems such as CMake. - Experience with unit, integration and automated testing frameworks. - A track record of designing and implementing systems that scale and stay maintainable. - Sound grounding in professional software engineering practice across the full development life cycle.

In unserem Produkt Basket Prediction entwickeln wir eine datengetriebene Lösung zur Reduktion von Inventurdifferenzen an Self-Checkout-Kassen. Jeden Tag werden in unseren Märkten Millionen von Artikeln gescannt und gekauft. Unsere Systeme analysieren Transaktionen, Warenkörbe, Rescan-Ergebnisse und Ereignisse aus Kassensystemen, um Auffälligkeiten frühzeitig zu erkennen und gezielt Rescans auszuwählen. Damit helfen wir, finanzielle Verluste nachhaltig zu reduzieren und gleichzeitig ein möglichst reibungsloses Einkaufserlebnis für unsere Kund:innen sicherzustellen. Die dafür entwickelten analytischen Erkenntnisse stellen wir über eine skalierbare Plattform anderen Produkten innerhalb der REWE Group zur Verfügung und gestalten so datengetriebene Entscheidungen im Handel aktiv mit. Aufgaben, die dich weiterbringen: Als Teil unseres cross-funktionalen Produktteams entwickelst und betreibst du Softwarelösungen, die täglich große Mengen an Transaktions- und Ereignisdaten verarbeiten und daraus konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ableiten. • Du schaffst messbaren Mehrwert für unsere Märkte, indem du dazu beiträgst Inventurdifferenzen zu reduzieren und Auffälligkeiten in Self-Checkout-Prozessen frühzeitig zu erkennen. • Du konzipierst, implementierst und betreibst cloudnative Services, die große Datenmengen zuverlässig verarbeiten und analytische Ergebnisse für andere Anwendungen bereitstellen. • Gemeinsam mit Fachbereichen, Analyst:innen und Product Partnern übersetzt du fachliche Anforderungen in skalierbare und nachhaltige Softwarelösungen. • Du entwickelst eventgetriebene Systeme, die Daten aus unterschiedlichen Quellen aufnehmen, verarbeiten und nahezu in Echtzeit nutzbar machen. • Du gestaltest den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus mit, von der Architektur über die Implementierung bis hin zu Betrieb und Monitoring. • Du entwickelst unsere technischen Standards weiter und bringst Themen wie Security by Design, Clean Code, Automatisierung und Softwarequalität aktiv in deine tägliche Arbeit ein. Features, die dich ausmachen: • Zuallererst deine Persönlichkeit: Du hast Freude daran, komplexe Fragestellungen zu analysieren und nachhaltige Lösungen zu entwickeln. Du denkst unternehmerisch, übernimmst Verantwortung und arbeitest gerne in interdisziplinären Teams. • Dein Software-Engineering-Know-how: Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und dem Betrieb moderner Backend- und Plattformlösungen. • Dein technisches Umfeld: Du bringst Erfahrung in cloudnativen Umgebungen mit. Technologien und Konzepte wie Python oder Go, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code und GitOps sind dir dabei vertraut. • Dein Blick für Qualität und Skalierung: Du kennst die Herausforderungen verteilter Systeme und hast Erfahrung mit Event Streaming und asynchroner Verarbeitung, beispielsweise mit Kafka, sowie mit der Verarbeitung großer Datenmengen und der Arbeit mit transaktionalen und analytischen Datenbanksystemen. Dabei legst du Wert auf wartbare Lösungen, hohe Softwarequalität, Automatisierung und Security by Design. Schön, wenn du außerdem Folgendes mitbringst: • Erfahrungen in der Entwicklung von Web-Frontends, beispielsweise mit Angular • Interesse an analytischen Verfahren und Machine-Learning-Modellen • Erfahrung im Handels-, E-Commerce- oder Datenumfeld Du erfüllst nicht jede Anforderung? Kein Problem. Wenn du dich in der Rolle grundsätzlich wiederfindest und Lust hast, dich gemeinsam mit uns weiterzuentwickeln, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. Basics, die das Leben noch besser machen: • Deine Life-Work-Integration durch flexible Arbeitszeiten, mobiles Arbeiten, 30 Tage Urlaub + regionale Brauchtumstage, Auszeitmodelle (Sabbatical, Pflegeauszeit etc.) und Betriebskindergarten. • Wir investieren in deine Zukunft. Mit deinem jährlichen Weiterbildungsbudget von ca. 2.000 € kannst du in Bezug auf deine individuelle Skillentwicklung lernen. Also bleib neugierig und sammle auf unserer eigenen Lernplattform, dem "IT Learning Hub", auf Fachkonferenzen, in Fachbüchern oder in einem von vielen kostenlosen Workshops aus unserem Learning Canvas neuen Input für dich und uns alle. • Updates für dich bei Inhouse Workshops und Events, wie dem Hackathon und Tech Talks sowie wöchentlichen Stand-Ups, regelmäßigen Tech All-Hands und Open Door-Formaten. • Dein Gestaltungsspielraum bei der Mitbestimmung deiner Hardware (MacBooks, ThinkPads) und des Betriebssystems (MacOS, Linux, Windows) - freu dich auf eine moderne IT-Ausstattung sowie einen breiten und innovativen Tech-Stack. • Dein Impact, weil du Anwendungen und Services für Millionen von Menschen entwickelst - mit über 1 Milliarde Datensätzen täglich, auf über 6 Millionen Handys, 32.000 Kassen oder in 7.300 Märkten. • Dein entspannter Arbeitsweg mit dem vergünstigten Deutschlandticket, einem Dienstrad und Parkplätzen direkt vor der Tür. • Unsere Netzwerke wie DITO - different together, SHINE, f.ernetzt, WomEngineers @REWE digital sowie Women's Drive machen uns zu einer bunten Community und unterstützen dich bei deiner persönlichen Weiterentwicklung. • Vorteile eines Konzerns für dich, z.B. in Form von Rabatten bei REWE, PENNY, toom Baumarkt und der DERTOUR Group, einer Rundumversorgung durch umfangreiche Gesundheitsleistungen, einer Unterstützung deiner Altersversorgung in Form von vermögenswirksamen Leistungen und der REWE Pensionskasse, Sonderleistungen wie Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld uvm. You handle end-to-end development, from building and testing to deployment and monitoring, ensuring reliable, production-ready software in collaboration with WIT, STT, and Product teams. description:
Job Title: Cloud Engineer

Key responsibilities:

¢ Design, implement and maintain secure, scalable and highly available cloud infrastructure on AWS.
¢ Create and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform and industry best practices.
¢ Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration management and deployment processes.
¢ Drive DevOps culture and automation across development and operations teams.
¢ Design, implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines to enable reliable and frequent releases.
¢ Collaborate with Software Engineers, Technical Leads and Architects to define cloud-native solutions and deployment strategies.
¢ Implement and maintain monitoring, observability, alerting and logging solutions across all environments.
¢ Ensure platform reliability, performance, scalability and operational excellence.
¢ Support incident management, root cause analysis and continuous improvement activities.
¢ Implement and maintain cloud security best practices including IAM, network security, secrets management and compliance controls.
¢ Optimise cloud resource utilisation and contribute to FinOps initiatives to improve cost efficiency.
¢ Define and document cloud architecture, technical designs, operational procedures and runbooks.
¢ Collaborate with product and engineering teams to ensure environments are aligned with delivery needs.
¢ Contribute to platform standardisation, reusable tooling and engineering governance initiatives.
¢ Foster a culture of continuous learning through knowledge sharing, workshops and technical mentoring.
¢ Delivery. Build and maintain reliable cloud platforms according to engineering standards.
¢ Code Quality. Follow and improve Infrastructure as Code and automation standards.
¢ Analyse & Estimate. Assess infrastructure requirements, technical risks and implementation effort.
¢ Software & Infrastructure Design. Create and review cloud architecture designs and infrastructure solutions.

Requirements

Strong experience with AWS services including EC2, ECS, EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, CloudFront, Route53, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, IAM, Secrets Manager, KMS, CloudWatch and Systems Manager (SSM).

Strong experience designing, implementing and operating cloud-native architectures on AWS.

Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, reusable modules and infrastructure automation.

Strong experience with containerisation technologies including Docker and Kubernetes.

Strong experience implementing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins or similar platforms.

Strong experience with source control management and Git-based development workflows.

Strong experience with observability platforms including CloudWatch, Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, Splunk and ELK.

Strong experience with monitoring, alerting, log aggregation, distributed tracing and application performance monitoring.

Strong experience implementing operational excellence practices including SLI, SLO and SLA management.

Strong experience troubleshooting production incidents, performing root cause analysis and driving preventative measures.

Good experience with Linux administration, networking and system troubleshooting.

Good experience with networking concepts including DNS, TCP/IP, VPN, CDN, Load Balancers, Reverse Proxies and TLS/SSL certificates.

Good experience with AWS networking services including VPC, Transit Gateway, Security Groups, Network ACLs, Route Tables, NAT Gateways and PrivateLink.

Good experience developing automation solutions using Python, Bash or similar technologies.

Strong knowledge of cloud security best practices including IAM, RBAC, least-privilege access, encryption, secrets management and vulnerability remediation.

Strong experience with AWS Security Hub, compliance frameworks and security remediation activities.

Experience implementing DevSecOps practices and integrating automated security controls into CI/CD pipelines.

Experience evaluating and integrating cloud security tooling for vulnerability assessments, penetration testing and threat modelling.

Experience supporting microservices and distributed architectures in production environments.

Experience implementing high-availability, disaster recovery and business continuity solutions.

Strong experience with cloud cost optimisation, FinOps practices and cloud consumption governance.

Experience using Cloudability or similar cloud financial management platforms to drive cloud visibility, optimisation and reporting.

Experience defining and implementing cloud tagging strategies, governance standards and operational compliance controls.

Experience designing and implementing automated remediation workflows.

Experience creating operational dashboards, alerting frameworks, reliability metrics and engineering KPIs.

Experience driving cloud migration initiatives, account onboarding and AWS platform transformations.

Experience building reusable platform components, self-service capabilities and developer enablement tooling.

Experience creating technical solution designs, architecture diagrams, operational runbooks and engineering documentation.

Strong understanding of cloud platform services as both a producer and consumer.

Strong understanding of release management, deployment strategies and environment management.

Strong experience with Agile delivery methodologies and engineering tooling including Jira, Confluence and GitHub.

DevOps as a mindset.

Customer-centric, passionate about delivering reliable digital platforms and services.

Demonstrating a true engineering craftsmanship mindset.

Passionate about continuous improvement, collaboration and great teams.

Strong problem-solving skills coupled with excellent communication skills.

Open-minded, inquisitive, life-long learner.

Comfortable with ambiguity and highly autonomous.

Benefits:

Flexible work hours

Remote work options

Professional development oppertunities

Collaborative and supportive work environment

description: Karbon is seeking a **Mid-Level**, Fullstack Software Engineer. This is an exciting time to join the team because we are expanding our organization. In this role, you will be working within an agile development team to design and build interactive web applications. They are responsible for technical specifications and developing and deploying software. **This role is focused on our API and Integrations team, with a lean towards Front-end.** ### **Key Responsibilities** - **Build and maintain product features -** Develop new functionality and iteratively improve existing systems, with a focus on reliability, performance, and user experience. - **Balance speed and quality -** Know when to move fast and when to slow down, making thoughtful trade-offs to deliver high-quality outcomes. - **Use data to inform decisions -** Learn from user behaviour, experiment thoughtfully including A/B testing where relevant, and help improve acquisition and conversion over time. - **Work effectively as part of a team -** Collaborate closely with engineers and QA throughout the development cycle to build, test, and improve features together - **Use AI tools thoughtfully -** Leverage AI to move faster for example drafting code, exploring solutions, or writing tests, while applying good judgement and always reviewing what ships. - **Work with autonomy -** Take ownership of problems, explore solutions, and ask questions when needed rather than waiting for predefined answers. - **Own your work -** Take pride in what you build and feel accountable for its impact on customers and the business. - **Bring your whole self -** Contribute your curiosity, creativity, and personality to an open, and collaborative team culture. ### **Qualifications:** We know great engineers come from many backgrounds. You don’t need to tick every box below to apply. - Solid frontend skills with experience using Javascript/Typescript and frameworks such as React.js, Angular.js, Vue.js, [Ember.js](http://ember.js) or equivalent. Comfortable working across the full stack and building rich, interactive user interfaces. - Strong fundamentals and hands-on experience building web applications using C#, .NET (MVC, Web API, .NET Core a plus) - Good understanding of RESTful APIs and how data flows through distributed systems, including designing and consuming web APIs. - Familiarity with SQL Server or relational databases, and an understanding of how data flows through an application - A growing understanding of software fundamentals like scalable systems, APIs, and basic data structures - Familiarity with the Azure Cloud Platform is a plus. - Curiosity and problem-solving skills- you enjoy figuring things out and learning as you go - A sense of ownership and pride in your work, balanced with a willingness to ask questions and accept feedback - An interest in building customer-facing software and thinking about how real people use what you build - Comfortable working with others - sharing ideas, giving and receiving feedback, and learning together - A degree in Computer Science (or similar), or equivalent practical experience #### **Our Core Technology Stack!** We build modern, scalable software on a thoughtfully designed stack: - **Frontend:** TypeScript and JavaScript across Ember (today), React, and React Native. - **Backend:**.NET / C# (Web API, .NET Core) powering distributed services. - **Data:** SQL Server with performance and integrity at scale. - **Cloud:** Microsoft Azure. - **Observability:** Metrics, logging, alerting, and dashboards in Datadog — because we believe you can’t improve what you don’t measure. Our architecture continues to evolve as we scale. We invest in event-driven systems, well-defined microservices, and containerized deployments (Azure Container Apps) to build resilient, decoupled, and high-performing software. If you care about clean service boundaries, reliable systems, and shipping with confidence — you’ll feel right at home here. #### **Why Work at Karbon?** - Gain global experience across the USA, Australia, New Zealand, UK, Canada and the Philippines - 4 weeks annual leave plus 5 extra "Karbon Days" off a year - Flexible working environment - Work with (and learn from) an experienced, high-performing team - Be part of a fast-growing company that firmly believes in promoting high performers from within - A collaborative, team-oriented culture that embraces diversity, invests in development, and provides consistent feedback - Generous parental leave #### **Our Engineering Standards** **Balance Speed and Quality** Engineers are expected to balance delivery speed with a strong commitment to quality, meeting agreed timelines while producing reliable, maintainable, and well-tested solutions. Sound judgment in making trade-offs between velocity and long-term sustainability is essential. **Collaborate Effectively** Engineering is collaborative by default. Team members are expected to contribute constructively in design discussions, reviews, and planning, communicate clearly about progress and risks, and support shared team outcomes in both hybrid and distributed environments. **Build and Maintain Systems** Engineers are responsible for building new capabilities while maintaining and improving existing systems. This includes designing scalable solutions, reducing technical debt, supporting operational stability, and contributing to continuous improvement. **Operate with Autonomy** A high degree of autonomy is expected. Given clear objectives, engineers should independently translate problems into actionable technical approaches, proactively identify improvements, and continuously expand relevant technical expertise. **Ownership and Accountability** Ownership is fundamental. Engineers are accountable for the quality, performance, and customer impact of their work from design through post-release support, and are expected to follow through on commitments. **AI-Enabled Engineering** AI is reshaping how software is built, and we are committed to leveraging it as a force multiplier for creativity, impact, and capability. Engineers are expected to confidently apply strong technical fundamentals while embracing AI tools and approaches to enhance productivity, problem-solving, and innovation. Curiosity, adaptability, and enthusiasm for integrating AI into meaningful product development are essential. **Contribute to Team Culture** Engineers contribute positively to a culture of professionalism, transparency, low bureaucracy, and mutual respect, strengthening team performance through authenticity, curiosity, and collaboration.

description: **Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.** Hey, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte! Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point. **Where and how you can work** Our flagship campus is in Sydney. We also have a campus in Melbourne and co-working spaces in Brisbane, Perth and Adelaide. But you have choice in where and how you work, we trust our Canvanauts to choose the balance that empowers them and their team to achieve their goals. **What you’d be doing in this role** As Canva scales change continues to be part of our DNA. But we like to think that's all part of the fun. So this will give you the flavour of the type of things you'll be working on when you start, but this will likely evolve. At the moment, this role is focused on: * You'll design, build, test and maintain software that contributes to intuitive and dependable user help experiences. * You'll independently deliver well-scoped engineering work, prioritising effectively with a moderate level of guidance and direction. * You'll analyse technical problems, consider possible solutions and use precedent and judgement to select an appropriate approach. * You'll collaborate with engineers and cross-functional partners to understand user and product needs and translate them into effective technical solutions. * You'll contribute to code reviews and team engineering practices, incorporating feedback and helping maintain a high standard of quality. * You'll investigate issues within your area of ownership and contribute to solutions that improve the reliability and effectiveness of the user experience. * You'll continue developing your engineering craft by learning from other Canvanauts and gaining exposure to systems and roles related to your own. **You're probably a match if** * You have strong experience with React programming languages * You have experience in AI tooling for software engineering (Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) * You have an understanding of APIs, integrations, and developer tooling * You have familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and the overall SDLC * You have the ability to implement solutions from technical specifications and collaborate effectively with senior engineers * You have strong communication skills and ability to document technical work clearly * You have the eagerness to learn about LLMs, AI agents, MCPs, and prompt engineering **About the team** We're part of Canva's User Voice Supergroup, where we're focused on empowering every user and making sure every voice is heard. Within User Voice, the User Help Experience Group is focused on empowering every user to get instant resolution to their issues. The AI Help Experience team context brings that ambition into the rapidly evolving world of AI-enabled support, creating opportunities to make help experiences faster, simpler and more useful. We work collaboratively across engineering and adjacent disciplines to turn user needs into dependable experiences. The work we do contributes directly to making Canva easier to use and helping our community get back to designing with confidence. **What's in it for you?** Achieving our crazy big goals motivates us to work hard - and we do - but you'll experience lots of moments of magic, connectivity and fun woven throughout life at Canva, too. We also offer a range of benefits to set you up for every success in and outside of work. Here's a taste of what's on offer: * Equity packages - we want our success to be yours too * Inclusive parental leave policy that supports all parents & carers * An annual Vibe & Thrive allowance to support your wellbeing, social connection, office setup & more * Flexible leave options that empower you to be a force for good, take time to recharge and supports you personally Check out lifeatcanva.com for more info. **Other stuff to know** We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture. When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process. We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva so even if you don’t feel like your skills quite match what’s listed above - we still want to hear from you! Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.

description: **Why You Should Join** * Ready to ignite your career at the forefront of AI innovation? As a Junior AI Engineer at OpenxAI, you’ll dive into the heart of a groundbreaking decentralized AI platform, crafting intelligent systems that redefine how the world interacts with technology. This isn’t just a role—it’s your ticket to collaborate with elite engineers, harness cutting-edge tools like TensorFlow and PyTorch, and deploy AI models on-chain that impact millions. If you’re driven by curiosity, obsessed with machine learning, and eager to shape the future of Web3, join our dynamic, global team and build tech that’s open, unstoppable, and revolutionary. Your journey to becoming an AI trailblazer starts here. **About OpenxAI** * OpenxAI is a permissionless, open AI network that enables anyone, anywhere to build and monetize AI apps and services using Web3 technologies — without banks, cloud accounts, approvals, or middlemen. The network is powered by decentralized GPU infrastructure and tokenized AI ownership, giving creators full control over their data, AI models, work, and rewards. * Born in Australia five years ago as an open-source initiative, we have since partnered with some of the world’s largest data centers and GPU providers to push the boundaries of decentralized compute. With a worldwide GPU pool up to 80 percent cheaper than AWS, Google, Azure, or Hugging Face, OpenxAI enables anyone — from a solo developer with a bold idea to a global AI startup — to launch at scale, instantly. * Our flagship platform, OpenxAI Studio, allows anyone to launch an AI company, deploy AI apps, or release AI agents in under five minutes — bringing production-grade AI to the hands of builders worldwide. * Our team consists of 40+ contributors and AI and Web3 veterans from across the industry, including builders from Fantom, AWS, Chainlink, Solana, ICP, Binance, NEAR, and AragonDAO. **Responsibilities** * Design, develop, and maintain software components for OpenxAI’s decentralized AI platform. * Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement backend and frontend features, including APIs and smart contract integrations. * Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code to support platform scalability and reliability. * Assist in testing and debugging to ensure high-quality, performant software solutions. * Contribute to the development of tools and infrastructure to enhance the platform’s decentralized capabilities. * What You Will Get * Direct access to a fast-scaling AI + Web3 project. * Work closely with a high-performance founder and engineering team on mission-critical activities. * Learn the inner workings of product, fundraising, growth, and partnerships. * Full flexibility — remote, async-friendly, focus is on results. * Growth opportunity to evolve into a senior engineering role or specialized software position for the right candidate. **Requirements** * Current enrollment in or recent graduation from a Bachelor’s degree program in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field at an Australian university. Students in their final years are strongly encouraged to apply. * Hands-on experience in software development through coursework, personal projects, internships, or research, including proficiency in languages like Python, JavaScript, or similar. * Familiarity with web development frameworks (e.g., React, Node.js) or blockchain technologies (e.g., smart contracts, decentralized systems) is a plus. * Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and basic understanding of software development best practices. * Eagerness to learn, adapt, and thrive in a dynamic, fast-moving startup environment.

description: **About Topsort** Topsort is the leading Retail Media Infrastructure company - we're democratizing the auction-based ad technology that was once exclusive to Amazon, Google, and Alibaba, and making it accessible to retailers, marketplaces, and delivery apps in 40+ countries worldwide. Our APIs power native sponsored listings, dynamic banners, and clean-room attribution at scale — all privacy-first, all real-time. We're a fast-growing, global-first team of ~100 people across Boston, Santiago, São Paulo, Barcelona, Sydney, and beyond. We move fast, we build in the open, and we hold a high bar — especially on infrastructure. **Why Topsort? Why now?** Topsort is changing the way Retail Media works. By joining our scaling team, you'll feel your impact from day 1. The processes and messaging you build today will be a critical part of our foundation as we accelerate toward 200 Topsorters worldwide, and your innovations will leave a lasting mark on the industry, as a whole. Retail Media is on the verge of a new era, and Topsort is gathering the ecosystem together to shape a brighter future. Joining us now, you'll work directly alongside our co-founders and founding members to bring on Retail Media 3.0. If you're looking to define your career as something greater than yourself, come scale with us. **What it’s like to work at Topsort** Our team is all about straightforward communication, embracing feedback without taking it personally, and fostering a super collaborative environment. It’s a sports team that’s hyper focused on winning, collaborative internally, and competitive externally - never the other way around. We thrive on working in the open, lifting each other up, and getting things done with a sense of urgency. We're the kind of team that loves making bold choices, sharing extraordinary opinions, and maintaining a 100 mph pace. No endless meetings here – if it can be done today, we're all about getting it done today. **What is this role like?** We're hiring a **Software Engineer for our Infrastructure team** — the backbone of everything Topsort runs on. This is not a supporting role. Infrastructure at Topsort is a first-class, mission-critical function. When our infrastructure is healthy, every retailer and marketplace our customers serve gets fast, reliable, and fair auction results. When it's not, we feel it everywhere. You'll be building and owning the systems that power our real-time auction engine, API platform, and internal developer tooling — at a scale and reliability standard that leaves no room for sloppiness. We need someone who treats production like it matters, because it does. **What You'll Do** - **Own the platform -** Design, build, and maintain the foundational infrastructure that every Topsort product and engineering team depends on, from compute and networking to deployment and observability. - **Raise reliability -** Define and enforce SLOs, build alerting systems that catch issues before customers do, and lead postmortems that actually prevent recurrence. - **Make deployments boring -** Build CI/CD pipelines and deployment systems that are so reliable they're invisible. Automate the toil out of every release. - **Manage infrastructure as code -** Own our cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP) through Terraform or equivalent — no snowflake servers, no manual configuration drift. - **Enable developers -** Build internal tooling and platform capabilities that make every Topsort engineer faster, safer, and more autonomous. Your customers are your colleagues. - **Harden security -** Implement and enforce security best practices at the infrastructure level — secrets management, network policies, RBAC, supply chain integrity. - **Scale proactively -** Capacity plan, load test, and tune our systems ahead of demand — not in reaction to a page at 2am. - **Participate in on-call -** We take production seriously. You'll join the on-call rotation and be expected to respond, resolve, and document. **What We Think You Need to Be Successful** We’re open to candidates who don’t check every box but show strong potential. - Bachelor's in Computer Science, engineering or a related field from top schools - 2–5 years of software engineering experience with a meaningful portion focused on infrastructure, platform, or SRE work - Solid hands-on experience with Kubernetes in production — not a homelab, not a tutorial, but real clusters under real load - Experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS preferred) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or similar) - Strong fundamentals in distributed systems — you understand CAP theorem, eventual consistency, and failure modes before they happen - Experience building or maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, or similar) - Comfort with observability tooling — metrics, logs, traces — and the discipline to use them proactively - A security-conscious mindset: you think about blast radius, principle of least privilege, and secrets rotation without being asked **You'll stand out if you have:** - Experience in high-throughput, low-latency systems (ad tech, fintech, real-time bidding, or similar) - Familiarity with service mesh, eBPF, or advanced Kubernetes networking - Experience with database infrastructure and data streaming - A track record of improving developer experience and reducing time-to-deploy - Experience at a high-growth startup where infra had to scale faster than the team **Who Thrives Here** Topsort engineering is not for everyone — and that's intentional. You'll do well here if: - You take **ownership seriously**. You don't wait to be assigned a problem. If you see something broken, you fix it or escalate immediately. - You write **production-grade code,** not proof-of-concepts. You document your work, write runbooks, and leave systems better than you found them. - You're **honest about tradeoffs**. We'd rather hear "this will take two weeks to do right" than ship something fragile under the guise of speed. - You **sweat the details** — especially in infra. A misconfigured RBAC rule, a missing circuit breaker, an oversized pod resource request — these things matter here. - You **communicate clearly** and often. We build in the open. Cross-functional collaboration is expected, not optional. - You're **intellectually curious** and you stay current. The infrastructure landscape moves fast. We expect engineers on this team to help us adopt the right new tools — and resist the wrong ones. *We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and to foster a workplace where diversity is valued and celebrated. We believe that diverse perspectives and experiences strengthen our teams and drive better outcomes. We respect and value any race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, caste, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, marital status, or military service.*

description: Help us build the future of public administration! Ayunis is a Munich-based GovTech company trusted by more than 800 cities, municipalities and districts across the DACH region. With Ayunis Core, we are building an open-source AI platform that automates repetitive administrative work. We use cutting-edge AI and engineering tools to build cutting-edge agentic technology—both for our customers and for our own development workflows. Tasks Your role As Principal Engineer, you will provide hands-on technical leadership across our product, integration platform and production infrastructure. Working closely with the CTO and engineering team, you will set technical direction, make critical architectural decisions and help other engineers deliver independently. You will remain close to code and production without becoming the bottleneck for every difficult problem. Your responsibilities Evolve the architecture of Ayunis Core across frontend, backend, agent runtime, identity, permissions and extension interfaces. Own the technical direction of our infrastructure, including deployments, reliability, observability, security and incident readiness. Build stable APIs, SDKs and reusable integration patterns for external systems such as document management systems and identity providers. Make pragmatic trade-offs between delivery speed, simplicity and long-term maintainability. Work with Product and customer-facing teams to turn recurring needs into reusable product capabilities. Collaborate with open-source contributors, software vendors and integration partners. Requirements What you bring Experience operating at Staff, Principal or a comparable level in a production software environment. Strong backend and systems architecture skills, ideally with TypeScript and Node.js. Hands-on experience with agent runtimes like LangChain, OpenAI Agent SDK, Mastra or similar. Hands-on experience with sovereign infrastructure, containers, CI/CD, scaling, observability and security. Experience designing APIs and integrations, such as OAuth/OIDC, webhooks, synchronization or event-driven systems. The ability to move between high-level architecture and hands-on implementation and debugging. A pragmatic product mindset: you judge technical decisions by their effect on reliability, delivery speed and customer value. The ability to set technical direction and lead engineers without relying on formal authority. An interest in using and systematically improving AI-assisted software development. Confident communication in German and English. Our stack TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, React, TanStack, PostgreSQL, Redis, S3-compatible storage, Docker Compose, Hetzner, GitHub Actions, OpenTelemetry and multiple LLM providers. No LangChain though – we've built our agent orchestration from the ground up. Benefits What we offer A competitive salary €2,000 annual personal development budget 30 days of holiday Significant influence over an open-source product and engineering organization Flexible working hours, hybrid work and EU workations Modern Munich office and equipment Regular team events and off-sites Public transport subsidy and Wellpass Interested? You have built joint go-to-market and co-marketing plans with partners and can own partner-sourced pipeline. You are a self-starter with a startup mindset, comfortable building a function from zero and owning the outcome. You are a confident presenter and trainer, at ease running enablement sessions, speaking at events, and representing the company at industry conferences. description: The BSA2A initiative Helsingâs mission is to protect our democracies. Delivering sovereign AI and mission-critical software capability requires exceptional engineering talent at every level. Following our recent funding and the success of early-career engineers across our teamsâincluding talent from our Formula Student partnershipsâwe are opening 20+ roles across our Deployed AI and Software Engineering teams. Traditional recruitment often places artificial barriers in front of early-career builders. Resumes rarely tell the full story of your technical depth, intuition, or drive. To solve this, we are piloting a direct, craft-first hiring path: Bring Something Awesome to Apply (BSA2A) . (This route is designed specifically for early-career engineers. It is entirely optional, you may still apply via our standard job listings if you prefer.) The process At the core of our technical interview philosophy is Bring Something Awesome (BSA) . A dedicated session where candidates present an ambitious technical project they have designed, built, or contributed to. With BSA2A , we are bringing this step to the very front of the application. Instead of an initial CV and recruiter screen, you apply by submitting a short (maximum 10-minute) prerecorded video walkthrough of something technically compelling you have built. We look for: Engineering depth & craft: High-quality code, solid architectural choices, and systems-level thinking. First-principles problem solving: The ability to deconstruct complex technical challenges autonomously. Clear technical communication: The ability to explain the how and why behind your trade-offs succinctly. Candidates selected through BSA2A move into an accelerated, streamlined technical assessment: Expression of Interest: Complete the short form below to confirm your eligibility. Our team will review submissions. Video Submission: Eligible candidates receive a private link with detailed guidance to upload their 10-minute BSA walkthrough. Every video is evaluated directly by a Helsing engineer not an algorithm or automated keyword filter. Technical Interviews (2 Ã 60 mins): Round 1: BSA Deep Dive & Systems Design . An interactive, technical exploration of your project and system trade-offs. Round 2: Live Coding . Practical, real-world algorithmic and problem-solving assessment. Final Interview (30 mins): A conversation with engineering leadership focused on mission alignment, collaboration, and how you work. Note: The initial form below is simply an expression of interest. You do not need your video recorded to submit this form. If your profile is eligible, we will send you dedicated instructions and a submission window. Why apply via this route? Evaluated on proof of work, not pedigree: Your code, architectural choices, and technical curiosity take centre stageânot university ranking, buzzwords, or CV formatting. Play to your strengths: Your application is assessed directly by Helsing engineers on what you can actually build, not how well you format a CV. Putting your real-world work front and centre gives you the highest signalâand the highest probability of success. Accelerated timeline: A focused, high-signal path that bypasses standard preliminary screens and reduces the overall interview cycle by two full stages. Who we are Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards. As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously. We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams â and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications. The role At Helsing we develop and deliver AI-based capabilities and the enabling infrastructure that allow semi-autonomous platforms to localise, navigate, and perceive the world in real time. We build software that is subject to significant and unorthodox technical constraints, must operate in a wide variety of constantly-changing environments, and has to support an ever-growing list of challenging use-cases. What we build ultimately ends up in the hands of real people in high-risk, high-stress situations, so must be both reliable and frictionless. Taken together, this brings a whole host of interesting engineering challenges across a wide variety of fields that youâll help us solve. The day-to-day Find more information on the day-to-day: Deployed AI Engineer and Software Engineer. *Please note, you need to apply via this page to be considered for the BSA2A process. You should apply if you Communicate well in English, both verbally and in writing, with the ability to articulate complex architectural decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Love figuring things out, digging deeper and deeper into unfamiliar systems until it finally clicks, and you understand how they work. Enjoy collaborating with others, including reviewing code and pair programming. Are comfortable solving problems with code . Feel like ethical considerations are an inherent part of software engineering. You can reason about and write code independently, without relying on LLMs. Helsing operates in environments where LLM use isn't always permitted, so our interviews are designed to let strong engineers succeed on the strength of their own thinking. Nice to have Experience with Python and Rust. Are familiar with backend interface tools like REST, GraphQL, gRPC/Protocol Buffers, and Arrow. Knowledge of container-based, cloud-native and edge application architectures. Hardware interfaces (e.g., Arduino). Robotics (e.g., control systems). Note: We operate at an intersection where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you donât meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points. Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields Helsingâs work is important. Youâll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns. The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world. Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward. In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts. We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. description: **About Lasting Dynamics** We're an independent software company, founded in 2015 and bootstrapped — no external investors. We build complex web and mobile products, and we're accountable for what we ship.** We're now scaling the team, tightening our engineering standards, and building AI into how we work day to day. **The role** We're hiring a Full Stack Engineer who already works with AI tools to join our team in Las Palmas. You'll build real products for international clients, own technical decisions, and grow toward more architectural responsibility over time. AI tools and autonomous agents are part of our workflow — you'll use them to move faster, raise code quality, and explore better solutions, while staying directly responsible for what you ship. This is a good fit if you have ~3 years of experience and want to go past a pure execution role: take on more ownership and grow as an engineer in a structured environment. **What you'll do** Build and maintain web applications with React, Next.js, and Node.js (TypeScript) Use AI tools (Claude, Copilot, Cursor, etc.) to ship faster and improve quality Work directly with designers, product owners, and other engineers Take part in technical discussions and contribute to system design Write clean, testable, maintainable code Do code reviews focused on quality and clarity Keep improving your own workflow **Must-haves** 3+ years building software Experience shipping web apps (frontend + backend) Solid grasp of clean code, testing, and maintainability Hands-on with React / Next.js and Node.js You already use AI coding tools (Claude, Copilot, Cursor, or similar) Problem-solving mindset and a drive to grow Good spoken and written English **Nice-to-haves** Basic system design knowledge Experience with a cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) Experience in teams with structured code reviews Genuine interest in AI, LLMs, or automation **What we offer** Complex, meaningful projects for international clients An AI-integrated development environment A clear growth path toward more autonomy and architecture An international, collaborative team A structured environment with solid engineering standards On-site work in Las Palmas de Gran Canaria **Relocating to Las Palmas** Las Palmas is our headquarters and home to most of our international team: engineering, product, and delivery work side by side here. The city pairs real career opportunities with a great quality of life: mild weather year-round, good international connectivity, and a safe, lively setting. We actively support people who relocate, with help on housing, admin/paperwork, and onboarding, so the move is smooth both professionally and personally.

description: Sijainti: HELSINKI Etsimme Data Engineeriä vahvistamaan Marketplace liiketoimintamme tiimiä. Pääset työskentelemään Suomen kattavimman asiakasdatan parissa, jota hyödynnämme asiakkaittemme parhaaksi. Tässä roolissa olet olennainen osa datavetoista verkkokauppaliiketoimintaamme, auttaen sitä saavuttamaan tavoitteensa ja tekemään asiakkaidemme arjesta sujuvampaa. Jos viihdyt tehtävässä, jossa saat sekä vastuuta että mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa, tämä rooli voi olla juuri sinua varten. Millaisesta tehtävästä on kyse? Data Engineerinä pääset datan hyödyntämisen eturintamaan. Rakennamme dataratkaisuja, jotka palvelevat yhtä Suomen suurimmista ja monipuolisimmista asiakasympäristöistä, ja juuri nyt olemme ottamassa merkittävää kehitysaskelta eteenpäin. Olemme hiljattain uudistaneet verkkokaupan data-alustamme, ja nyt kiihdytämme vauhtia hyödyntääksemme sen tarjoamat mahdollisuudet täysimääräisesti. Tehtävä sijoittuu uuden marketplace-liiketoiminnan pariin, jossa tekemistä leimaa vauhdikas kehitystahti, suuret datamäärät ja liiketoiminnan jatkuva kehittyminen. Liityt osaksi tiimiä kehittämään ja ylläpitämään tietovarastoa sekä siihen liittyviä dataputkia. Vastaat ETL-prosesseista sekä datan tallennuksen, saatavuuden ja tietoturvan optimoinnista. Roolissasi kehität uusia ja ylläpidät olemassa olevia datan transformointikäytäntöjä. Työskentelypaikkana meillä on Helsingin toimistomme, Ässäkeskus, jossa kohtaamme kollegoidemme kanssa 2-3 kertaa viikossa. Työtehtävien salliessa voit myös joustavasti työskennellä etänä osan viikosta. Minkälaista osaajaa etsimme? Etsimme henkilöä, joka yhdistää vahvan oppimishalun kykyyn omaksua uusia asioita nopeasti. Saatat olla ottamassa seuraavaa askelta data engineering -urallasi tai sinulla voi jo olla kokemusta vastaavista vaativista tehtävistä. Molemmissa tapauksissa nautit työskentelystä erilaisten datakokonaisuuksien parissa ja ymmärrät datan merkityksen päätöksenteossa. Toivomme sinulta hyviä viestintä- ja yhteistyötaitoja, joiden avulla työskentelet sujuvasti erilaisten sidosryhmien kanssa. Lisäksi edellytämme sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa. Menestyt tehtävässä erityisesti, jos sinulla on: vahvaa osaamista datamallinnuksesta sekä dataputkien rakentamisesta ja orkestroinnista vahvat tekniset taidot data-alustoista ja -ratkaisuista (AWS, Snowflake, dbt) sekä käytännön ohjelmointiosaamista (esimerkiksi Python ja SQL) kokemusta infrastruktuurin määrittelystä Terraformilla sekä CI/CD-käytännöistä käytännön kokemusta reaaliaikaisen datan suoratoistoteknologioista, kuten Kafkasta liiketoiminta- ja asiakaslähtöinen ajattelutapa sekä kyky nähdä data tuotteina oma-aloitteinen ja asioita eteenpäin vievä työote jatkuva halu oppia ja kehittää uutta kokemusta tekoälyä hyödyntävästä kehityksestä vähintään viiden vuoden kokemus vastaavista vaativista tehtävistä Miksi valita meidät? Meillä pääset vaikuttamaan miljoonien Suomessa asuvien ihmisten arkeen. Saat vastuuta ja aidon mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa työsi sisältöön. Insinööreillämme on paljon vapautta työssään, mutta samalla he kantavat vastuun rakentamistaan ratkaisuista, joita käyttävät päivittäin miljoonat asiakkaat. Meillä et ole mukana vain projektissa, vaan omistat tuotteen ja kehität palveluita suoraan loppukäyttäjille. Lisäksi: Hyvästä ja tuloksellisesta tekemisestä palkitaan, ja meillä jokainen työntekijä on tulospalkkauksen piirissä. Saat käyttöösi Suomen laajimmat henkilöedut, mikä tarkoittaa alennuksia ruoasta, ravintoloista, hotelleista, elektroniikasta, meikeistä, kurahousuista, kodinkoneista tai vaikkapa autopesusta. Meillä työskennellessä, elämä työn ulkopuolella on vähän helpompaa ja paljon hauskempaa. Eduistamme voit lukea lisää TÄÄLTÄ. S-ryhmän on Suomen suurin yksityinen työnantaja, joten täältä eivät mahdollisuudet lopu. Meillä urapolut ovat usein pitkiä, toisinaan mutkittelevia, mutta aina mahdollisuuksia täynnä. Olemme kotimainen yritysryhmä. Veroeuromme jäävät suurimmaksi osaksi lähiseudulle, samoin kuin hankinnasta ja rakentamisesta koituva hyöty. SOK:n ja koko S-ryhmän suuri vaikutus tuo merkityksellisyyttä työarjen keskelle. Me S-ryhmässä olemme sitoutuneet työskentelemään monimuotoisen ja syrjimättömän työympäristön puolesta, jossa kunnioitetaan ja arvostetaan kaikkien työntekijöidemme ainutlaatuisia taustoja, taitoja ja näkemyksiä. Miltä vaikutti? Voisitko olla uusi kollegamme? Jos tämä tehtävä vaikutti mielestäsi lupaavalta, haethan viimeistään 25.10.2026. Rekrytointiprosessimme aikana pääset tapaamaan tulevan esihenkilösi, rekrytoijan sekä tulevia tiimiläisiäsi. Lisäksi pääset osallistumaan soveltuvuusarviointiin, joka sisältää työpersoonallisuuskyselyn sekä kykytestit ja purkukeskustelun. #SOK #SOKDigitalTalent

description: Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines. At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth. How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here. We are looking for an engaged and passionate Senior Data Engineer to join our growing Engineering Team. In this role, you will be a key member of the team managing our analytics and event platform stack. As part of the Analytics & Data Platform team, you will build features for over 22,000 customers across the globe. Your work will unlock the value of data, empowering our customers to make informed decisions through real-time insights, monitoring, and comprehensive analytical reports. Your role at Aircall Have key responsibilities within the requirements analysis, scalable & low latency streaming platform solution design, architecture, and end-to-end delivery of key modules in order to provide near real-time data solutions for our product Analyze and translate business needs into data model & optimize for big data Identify slow queries and optimize for better performance Write clean scalable code using Scala / python / SQL and test and deploy applications and systems Solve our most challenging data problems, in near real-time, utilizing optimal data architectures, frameworks, query techniques, sourcing from structured and unstructured data sources. Be part of an engineering organization delivering high quality, secure, and scalable solutions to Aircall clients Involvement in product and platform performance optimization and live site monitoring Mentor team members through giving and receiving actionable feedback. Our tech. stack: AWS (Kinesis,Kafka, s3, DMS, Glue, EMR, EKS, Redshift, Spectrum), Apache Pinot, Apache Flink and Airflow. A continuous deployment process based on GitLab A little more about you: A Bachelor's degree in a technical field (eg. computer science or mathematics). 3+ years experience with near real-time analytics 5+ years experience with a modern programming language such as Scala, Python, Go, Typescript Experience of designing complex data processing pipeline Experience of data modeling (star schema, dimensional modeling etc) in AWS redshift Experience of query optimisation Experience of kafka is a plus Shipping and maintaining code in production You like sharing your ideas, and you're open-minded Why join us? 🚀 Key moment to join Aircall in term of growth and opportunities 💆‍♀️ Our people matter, work-life balance is important at Aircall 📚 Fast-learning environment, entrepreneurial and strong team spirit 🌍 45+ Nationalities: cosmopolite & multi-cultural mindset 💶 Competitive salary package & benefits (health coverage, lunch, commute, sports) DE&I Statement: At Aircall, we believe diversity, equity and inclusion, irrespective of origins, identity, background and orientations, are core to our Aircall journey. description: # Your Mission As a Catawiki Live Business Developer, you will help scale Catawiki Live, a key growth initiative that extends Catawiki’s auction experience through live shopping events. You will build and develop a pipeline of high-potential sellers, support their onboarding, and help them grow successfully on the platform. Working closely with commercial teams, category experts and other stakeholders, you will contribute to sustainable revenue growth by supporting sellers throughout the early stages of their journey on Catawiki Live. # What You’ll Do - Identify, qualify and develop new seller leads through online research, outreach and collaboration with sales representatives and category experts. - Activate high-potential sellers to join Catawiki Live and expand the seller pipeline. - Onboard new sellers to Catawiki Live, helping them understand how to succeed in the live auction format. - Support a smooth pre- and post-live experience for newly onboarded sellers. - Collaborate with category experts and internal stakeholders to develop growth plans for sellers. - Build educational content for the Catawiki Live Seller Academy to help sellers maximise success through live auctions. - Develop category knowledge to better support sellers and identify growth opportunities. # What You’ll Bring - A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business or a related field. - At least 1 year of relevant experience, including internships or similar commercial roles. - A strong commercial mindset with excellent communication skills. - An entrepreneurial approach and strong problem-solving abilities. - An interest in online marketplaces, with an affinity for collecting or understanding seller communities. - Experience using Google Workspace tools, including Google Sheets and Google Slides. - Fluency in English and Dutch with additional European languages, and knowledge of live streaming platforms considered a plus. # How We Work - Collaborate closely with sales teams, category experts and other internal stakeholders. - Support sellers throughout the early stages of their journey on Catawiki Live. - Contribute to a cross-functional growth initiative focused on scaling Catawiki Live. - Learn about marketplace commercial functions, including Sales and Category Management, while developing seller growth strategies. # Where You’ll Be This is a hybrid role based in Amsterdam. You will work from our Amsterdam HQ a minimum of 2 days per week.

Strong experience working with REST APIs and third-party integrations. 3. Practical experience with API authentication, including OAuth and token-based authentication. 4. Experience working with webhooks, API rate limits, pagination, retries, error handling, and data synchronization. 5. Solid understanding of relational databases and ORMs, preferably Django ORM. 6. Strong debugging and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently investigate unfamiliar issues and identify root causes. 8. Experience working with e-commerce workflows, including products, variants, inventory, orders, pricing, customers, and catalog structures. 2. Experience building or maintaining data synchronization systems between multiple platforms. 3. Familiarity with background jobs, queues, scheduled tasks, or asynchronous processing. 4. Experience working with cloud platforms, logging/monitoring tools, CI/CD, or production debugging. 5. Exposure to additional programming languages, frameworks, databases, or third-party platforms. 6. Experience improving existing systems rather than only developing new features from scratch. **What We Value** Beyond technical skills, we value developers who: * Take ownership instead of waiting for instructions. * Think about the actual problem and its root cause, not just the assigned task. * Are comfortable investigating and solving unfamiliar problems independently. * Ask the right questions before jumping into implementation. * Continuously learn and improve their technical skills. * Care about the quality and reliability of what they build. * Are willing to experiment, make mistakes, learn, and improve. * Communicate clearly and work well with the rest of the team.

In order to bring our solution even faster to the top in the energy world, we are looking for you as a **Senior Product Engineer (Full Stack)**. Here's what you'll do: * **Immerse yourself in our tech stack**: Microfrontends, serverless AWS, and best-in-class developer tooling and automation. Learn more here: [docs.epilot.io](https://docs.epilot.io/docs/architecture/overview) * **Be part of a cross-functional dream team**: Collaborate with full-stack, backend, and frontend developers, designers, and product managers to deliver impactful features. * **Work end-to-end**: From ideation to delivery, you'll team up with product management and design to bring features to life and make product decisions. * **Take ownership**: Got an idea? Draft an RFC (Request for Comment), drive the initiative, and own it from start to finish. * **Foster growth**: Mentor colleagues, share knowledge, and continuously learn new technologies. * **Innovate with agility**: Participate in diverse, exciting development projects, leveraging pair programming and agile methodologies. #### What you bring We're looking for a **Product-Minded Engineer** who resonates with our values and has the following skills and mindset: * **Product Thinking**: You care about delivering value to customers and users, not just writing code. * **Technical Expertise**: * Hands-on experience with **React** or other JavaScript frameworks. * Knowledge of **RESTful APIs** or **GraphQL**. * Familiarity with **microservices architecture** and **public/private cloud platforms** (AWS, GCP, Azure). * Basic understanding of application and cloud security principles, and how to build secure, reliable software. * **Ownership Mentality**: You take initiative, drive features to completion, and thrive on responsibility. * **Entrepreneurial Spirit**: You think like a business owner, understanding how your work impacts our goals. * **Problem-Solver**: You see challenges as opportunities for growth. * **Collaborative Mindset**: You're a true team player who motivates and inspires those around you. * **Agile Know-How**: You're familiar with methodologies like Scrum, Kanban, or XP and understand how to apply them effectively. #### What we offer you At epilot, we believe in rewarding performance, fostering growth, and creating an environment where you'll thrive: * **Impactful Work**: Be part of a product-driven company that's reshaping the energy sector. * **Startup Mentality**: Enjoy a dynamic atmosphere with flat hierarchies and open communication. * **Flexibility**: Work remotely or from our centrally located office in Cologne, with flexible working hours. * **Growth Opportunities**: Your career will grow as fast as we do. Learn, experiment, and embrace a "Fail Fast and Often" mentality. * **Competitive Compensation**: We take your desired salary seriously and value performance. * **Team Spirit**: Join us for regular events like summer parties, company breakfasts, and our epic annual epilot summit, where you'll connect with co-epilots worldwide. * **Transparency and Openness**: Everything is open for discussion in our inclusive and supportive culture. ### What to/we expect in your first 180days -read full version: [here](https://expectation.epilot.dev/)- **By Week 1 you will:** * Pair with a colleague and **ship something**. Already shipping the first iteration of it * Have a good understanding of the codebase and how our services connect * Know enough about our customers and domain to push back on bad ideas, including ours **By Month 3-6 you will:** * Be the undisputed **owner of your domain**: the go-to person, the one who spots problems before they're reported and fixes them before they're assigned * Have shipped something that visibly moved a metric: adoption, reliability, performance, or revenue * Operate fully autonomously. Not just through your own work, but through your reviews, your feedback, and how you onboard whoever we hire after you We are looking forward to your application! Check out our promise to you: [promise.epilot.cloud](http://www.promise.epilot.cloud/) P.S.: If you want to learn more about the application process, please read Eka's blog article: [How to get hired at epilot](https://dev.to/epilot/how-to-get-hired-at-epilot-step-by-step-guide-4ei1)

description: Job posting no. Weitere Informationen über die Art dieser Stelle und die Erwartungen an die Bewerber finden Sie weiter unten. 20260819 The GWDG is seeking a Quantum Software Engineer (m/f/d) to join an interdisciplinary team of HPC experts in the working group “Computing” (AG C), full-time (39 hours per week), remunerated in accordance with TVöD E 13. The position is tied to the GWDG QC project’s runtime running till October 2029. The successful candidate is expected to contribute in developing GWDG’s QC ecosystem (see responsibilities listed below). The GWDG handles sensitive data, and in such cases, it is important that the code is human-verified for any security concerns. The applicant must demonstrate the ability to do such a verification without AI assistance in the interview. The Gesellschaft für wissenschaftliche Datenverarbeitung mbH Göttingen (GWDG) is the university computing center for the Georg-August-Universität Göttingen and a computing and IT competence center for the Max Planck Society. The provision of high-performance HPC systems has been one of its tasks for over 40 years. In 2020, the University of Göttingen / GWDG was accepted as one of eight computing centers ( öttingen) in the National High-Performance Computing (NHR) network. The GWDG also operates the national AI service center KISSKI and is a partner in the EU AI Factory HammerHAI. Furthermore, the GWDG operates HPC resources for the German Aerospace Center (DLR). As a national supercomputing center, the GWDG provides technical support to researchers and students from various scientific domains, including digital humanities, life science, earth system science, and engineering. We also participate in both national and international research projects. In the field of quantum computing, the GWDG also runs the QUICS project, providing SMEs with access to quantum computing resources. We are looking for highly motivated candidates to join the QC team at the GWDG focused on anomaly detection for industry applications. The goal is to build a platform for such use cases based on existing stacks, giving companies a tool for quantum anomaly detection. The GWDG together with the Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Science and the Campus Institute Data Science (CIDAS) of the University of Göttingen provides a stimulating research environment in Scientific Computing, with an opportunity to conduct research in the intersection of applied computer science, High-Performance Computing, Quantum Computing, and AI. Responsibilities Focus: Implementing a containerized FullStaQD instance as a reference implementation for the entire project landscape. This requires a high level of competence in software architecture and quality management. The developer must: Implement a modular, scalable infrastructure Establish CI/CD pipelines and automated testing frameworks Handle heterogeneous APIs Integrate HPC scheduler systems (e.g., SLURM) Adhere to data protection and security standards (DSGVO-compliant encryption) Requirements PhD and/or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Physics, or a related field, combined with demonstrable industry or research experience Proven coding experience (without AI assistance): scope, functions, variables, classes, array methods, etc. Experience in software architecture and quality management for containerized systems Experience handling heterogeneous APIs and integrating HPC scheduler systems (e.g., SLURM) Knowledge in QC (quantum computing) job characteristics and resource requirements, and familiarity with compiler/transpiler pipelines Knowledge of encryption and data protection standards Excellent teamwork and communication skills Fluent English (spoken and written) Do you fit all the above requirements? Then we welcome your application! Desirable Experience with Docker/Kubernetes and building CI/CD pipelines Experience integrating heterogeneous third-party APIs into a unified platform Experience with platform development, especially using Django Familiarity with HPC scheduler systems (e.g., SLURM) in a web-facing application context Experience with Slurm-native middleware or API-gateway architectures (e.g., similar to GWDG’s SAIA) Knowledge of DSGVO/GDPR-compliant data handling and encryption in production systems German B2 or higher Our offer Flexible working hours and opportunity for partial mobile working A modern, diverse work environment at the intersection between academia and industry An interesting, versatile job in a large, internationally operating IT competence center Qualification and further development of your skills Social benefits of the public sector Your application Have we sparked your interest? Then please send us your application by 3 via our online form: The GWDG strives for gender equity and diversity and therefore welcomes applications from any background. The GWDG strives to employ more severely disabled people. xfmxmju Applications from severely disabled persons are expressly encouraged. If you have any questions about the advertised position, please contact Dr. Jan Cillié Louw (e-mail: ).
