Perustukset uudelle tietovarastolle ovat jo olemassa, mutta tekemistä riittää vielä runsaasti. Tämä on erinomainen mahdollisuus päästä vaikuttamaan sekä teknisiin ratkaisuihin että data-alustan tulevaan suuntaan. Tehtävän päätarkoitus on rakentaa ja ylläpitää tietoputkia sekä niiden orkestrointia eri järjestelmien välillä siten, että data virtaa luotettavasti, oikea-aikaisesti ja laadukkaasti analytiikan, raportoinnin, tekoälyn ja muiden liiketoiminnan käyttötapausten tarpeisiin. Pääset toteuttamaan uuden tietovaraston rakentamista sekä osallistumaan laajojen datakokonaisuuksien migraatioihin nykyisestä ympäristöstä moderneihin ratkaisuihin. Vastaat uusien tietoputkien, tietomallien ja dataratkaisujen kehittämisestä sekä niiden dokumentoinnista ja jatkuvasta kehittämisestä. Huolehdit myös julkaistujen datatuotteiden kehityksestä, ylläpidosta ja laadusta. Työpäiväsi koostuvat data-alustan kehittämisestä, teknisestä ongelmanratkaisusta, tiedon mallintamisesta, datan laadun varmistamisesta sekä yhteistyöstä liiketoiminnan ja muiden dataosaajien kanssa. Roolissa sinulla on teknistä omistajuutta valituista ratkaisuista ja mahdollisuus vaikuttaa merkittävästi siihen, miten uusi data-alusta rakennetaan ja kehittyy tulevaisuudessa. Hyödynnät arjessa sujuvasti ja laadukkaasti tekoälyä oman työsi tukena. Työskentelypaikkana meillä on Helsingin toimistomme, Ässäkeskus, jossa kohtaamme kollegoidemme kanssa 2-3 kertaa viikossa. Työtehtävien salliessa voit myös joustavasti työskennellä etänä osan viikosta. Minkälaista osaajaa etsimme? Etsimme kokenutta Data Engineeriä, joka innostuu suurten datakokonaisuuksien parissa työskentelystä ja haluaa olla rakentamassa uutta data-alustaa pitkäjänteisesti. Menestyt tehtävässä, jos nautit teknisestä ongelmanratkaisusta, modernien dataratkaisujen kehittämisestä sekä vastuullisesta roolista liiketoimintakriittisen datan parissa. Toivomme sinulta: vähintään viiden vuoden kokemusta Data Engineer -tehtävistä tai vastaavasta datakehityksestä kokemusta tietoputkien, dataintegraatioiden ja tiedonmallien suunnittelusta, toteuttamisesta ja ylläpidosta vahvaa SQL- ja Python-osaamista sekä kokemusta datan laadun varmistamisesta käytännön kokemusta AWS-pohjaisten dataratkaisujen rakentamisesta, erityisesti Glue-, Athena- ja Lake Formation -palveluiden hyödyntämisestä kokemusta modernista data stackista, kuten Snowflakesta, dbt:stä sekä data lake -ratkaisuista ymmärrystä Apache Icebergistä ja kokemusta suurten datamassojen käsittelystä PySparkilla kykyä suunnitella ja toteuttaa teknisiä ratkaisuja itsenäisesti sekä huomioida niiden vaikutukset datan laatuun, luotettavuuteen ja kustannustehokkuuteen hyviä yhteistyö- ja viestintätaitoja sekä kykyä työskennellä sujuvasti eri data- ja liiketoimintatiimien kanssa soveltuvaa teknistä korkeakoulututkintoa Arvostamme lisäksi kokemusta CI/CD-käytännöistä, infrastruktuurin automatisoinnista sekä moderneista data-alustoista ja pilvipalveluista laajemmin. Kokemus asiakasdatan, kanta-asiakkuuksien tai laajojen analytiikkaratkaisujen parissa työskentelystä katsotaan eduksi. Miksi valita meidät? Tässä roolissa pääset mukaan rakentamaan kokonaan uutta tietovarastoa yhdelle S-ryhmän tärkeimmistä liiketoiminta-alueista. Et tule ylläpitämään valmista ratkaisua, vaan olet mukana määrittämässä, millaiseksi uusi data-alusta rakentuu. Lisäksi: Hyvästä ja tuloksellisesta tekemisestä palkitaan, ja meillä jokainen työntekijä on tulospalkkauksen piirissä. Saat käyttöösi Suomen laajimmat henkilöedut, mikä tarkoittaa alennuksia ruoasta, ravintoloista, hotelleista, elektroniikasta, meikeistä, kurahousuista, kodinkoneista tai vaikkapa autopesusta. Meillä työskennellessä, elämä työn ulkopuolella on vähän helpompaa ja paljon hauskempaa. Eduistamme voit lukea lisää TÄÄLTÄ. S-ryhmän on Suomen suurin yksityinen työnantaja, joten täältä eivät mahdollisuudet lopu. Meillä urapolut ovat usein pitkiä, toisinaan mutkittelevia, mutta aina mahdollisuuksia täynnä. Olemme kotimainen yritysryhmä. Veroeuromme jäävät suurimmaksi osaksi lähiseudulle, samoin kuin hankinnasta ja rakentamisesta koituva hyöty. SOK:n ja koko S-ryhmän suuri vaikutus tuo merkityksellisyyttä työarjen keskelle. Me S-ryhmässä olemme sitoutuneet työskentelemään monimuotoisen ja syrjimättömän työympäristön puolesta, jossa kunnioitetaan ja arvostetaan kaikkien työntekijöidemme ainutlaatuisia taustoja, taitoja ja näkemyksiä. Miltä vaikutti? Voisitko olla uusi kollegamme? Jos tämä tehtävä vaikutti mielestäsi lupaavalta, haethan viimeistään 25.10.2026. Rekrytointiprosessimme aikana pääset tapaamaan tulevan esihenkilösi, rekrytoijan sekä tulevia tiimiläisiäsi. Lisäksi pääset osallistumaan soveltuvuusarviointiin, joka sisältää työpersoonallisuuskyselyn sekä kykytestit ja purkukeskustelun. #SOK #SOKDigitalTalent

description: We are looking for a full stack engineer who builds software that stays clear, fast and dependable when the people using it are under real pressure. Praetori builds Continuous Control Infrastructure: one sovereign software layer that keeps the operational picture, the decision and the action connected while conditions change, for Europe's defence, intelligence and critical-infrastructure operators. This role is open to candidates based in the Netherlands (hybrid out of our Haarlem base) and candidates based in Portugal (working from home with part-time time in our Porto office). **About the role** The interface between an operator and the system is where our software earns trust or loses it. Our users make consequential decisions in compressed time, often in degraded conditions. The product has to make the right action obvious, absorb complexity on their behalf, and never get in the way. That standard runs from the pixel to the data model. You own significant parts of the product end to end: architecture, interfaces, data flows and performance. **What you'll do** - Design and build core product features end to end, from data model and API to interface. - Build interfaces in TypeScript, React and Next.js that stay clear and responsive under pressure. - Design backend services and APIs in Node.js that are correct, observable and fast. - Treat performance as a feature. Latency, responsiveness and reliability are part of the product. - Work with design to turn complex operational workflows into interfaces that feel inevitable. - Harden field prototypes from forward deployed engineers into production-grade features. **What you bring** - A production system you built end to end that people use daily, and the calls you made to keep it fast. - Deep TypeScript expertise across the stack, with strong React and Next.js on the front end. - Solid backend engineering in Node.js: APIs, data modelling and services built to last. - Real care for UX and product outcomes. Fluent English. Right to work in the EU. **Nice to have** - Complex, data-dense or real-time interfaces: dashboards, operational tooling, mapping, monitoring. - Background in high-reliability software where failure carries real consequences. - Interest in the mission: defence, security and critical infrastructure. **Pay** Portugal: EUR 42,000 to 58,000 gross per year, plus meaningful equity and a performance bonus. Netherlands: market-rate salary, equity and bonus. **Process** Three interviews: a 60 minute first interview, a 90 minute live technical session worked together (no take-home), and a conversation with the co-founders. Then references and EU security screening. Full description: https://www.praetori.ai/company/careers/founding-full-stack-developer

description: ## Help build the AI Operating System for Product Operations Retailers and brands spend billions developing, sourcing and selling products, yet much of the work behind every product is still manual. Product data lives across spreadsheets, emails, supplier portals and disconnected systems. Teams spend countless hours chasing suppliers, reviewing documents, checking compliance requirements and preparing products for sale. **SupplyScope changes that.** We’re building the AI Operating System for Product Operations, giving retailers and brands a single workspace where AI agents work alongside product, compliance and merchandising teams to automate the repetitive work behind every product. Today, our platform manages millions of products across global supply chains for leading retailers in Australia and Europe. Every day our AI agents read technical documents, enrich product information, verify compliance, engage suppliers and help teams launch products faster with greater confidence. We’re looking for an experienced Full Stack Developer to help build the next generation of our platform. ## What you’ll be building This isn’t an AI wrapper around ChatGPT. You’ll help build domain-specific AI agents that solve real operational problems across the product lifecycle. Examples include: - Reading technical specifications, certifications and compliance reports - Extracting and validating structured product information - Engaging suppliers to verify missing information - Building intelligent workflows that combine AI reasoning with deterministic business rules - Scaling these capabilities across millions of products Alongside our AI platform, you’ll also build the core application that retailers use every day to manage products, suppliers, compliance and product development. You’ll own features end-to-end, from database design through to polished user experiences. ## Our tech stack - Laravel - PHP 8+ - React - TypeScript - Inertia.js - Tailwind CSS - Filament - PostgreSQL - GCP - OpenAI and frontier AI models - Vector search and retrieval - Pest and Playwright - GitHub Actions You’ll work across the entire stack rather than being confined to front-end or back-end only. ## What you’ll do - Design and build new platform features - Develop AI agents and intelligent workflows - Improve retrieval, evaluation and agent orchestration - Optimise large-scale data processing across millions of products - Work closely with customers to solve genuine operational challenges - Help shape the architecture of a rapidly growing AI platform ## We’re looking for someone who - Has strong Laravel and modern PHP experience - Enjoys building with React and TypeScript - Has experimented with or built production AI applications - Understands databases and performance - Likes solving complex problems rather than simply shipping tickets - Enjoys working in a small team where your work has visible impact You don’t need experience with every technology we use. Curiosity, ownership and strong engineering fundamentals matter more. ## Why SupplyScope? You’ll join an ambitious founding team building one of Australia’s fastest-growing enterprise AI companies. Rather than building generic AI tools, we’re creating software that becomes part of how retailers and brands develop, source and launch products. That means solving problems involving: - AI - Product development - Compliance - Supply chains - Enterprise workflows - Large-scale structured data It’s a unique mix of software engineering, AI and real-world operational challenges. If you enjoy ownership, shipping quickly and working on meaningful technical problems, you’ll feel right at home. ## About SupplyScope SupplyScope is the AI Operating System for Product Operations. We help retailers and brands centralise product, supplier and compliance information while deploying AI agents to automate product enrichment, supplier collaboration and compliance workflows. Our platform supports millions of products across global supply networks and is trusted by leading retailers in Australia and Europe. We’re VC-backed and were recognised as one of the Australian Financial Review BOSS Most Innovative Companies.

title: BackEnd Engineer: Experiments
snippet: ## **About us** Constructor is the next-generation platform for search and discovery in ecommerce, built to explicitly optimize for metrics like revenue, conversion rate, and profit. Our search engine is entirely invented in-house utilizing transformers and generative LLMs, and we use its core and personalization capabilities to power everything from search itself to recommendations to shopping ag
description: ## **About us** Constructor is the next-generation platform for search and discovery in ecommerce, built to explicitly optimize for metrics like revenue, conversion rate, and profit. Our search engine is entirely invented in-house utilizing transformers and generative LLMs, and we use its core and personalization capabilities to power everything from search itself to recommendations to shopping agents. Engineering is by far our largest department, and we've built our proprietary engine to be the best on the market, having never lost an A/B test to a competitive technology. We're passionate about maintaining this and work on the bleeding edge of AI to do so. Out of necessity, our engine is built for extreme scale and powers over 1 billion queries every day across 150 languages and roughly 100 countries. It is used by some of the biggest ecommerce companies in the world like Sephora, Under Armour, and Petco. We're a passionate team who love solving problems and want to make our customers' and coworkers' lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they do best can lead to great things. Constructor is a U.S. based company that has been in the market since 2019. It was founded by Eli Finkelshteyn and Dan McCormick who still lead the company today. ## **About the Team** The Experiments team at Constructor builds an experimentation platform: traffic allocation, exposure logging, metric computation, statistical analysis, and a UI for launching experiments and interpreting results. It’s used both internally and by customers running experiments on production traffic. We’re scaling customer experimentation usage and investing in making experiments faster, more reliable, and easier to interpret. Unlike boxed experimentation tools, our platform has to support a wide range of customer integrations, traffic patterns, and industry constraints — which makes the engineering problems unusually real-world and high-leverage. Team: 3 Software Engineers, 1 Data Analyst, an Engineering Manager, and a Product Manager. ## **The Role** This is primarily a backend role (Python services + data-heavy systems). You’ll occasionally work in the Dash UI and contribute to Spark jobs, but those are not the main focus. We care about correctness, observability, and product usability more than complex infrastructure. Tech: Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Plotly Dash, PySpark/Databricks, AWS, CloudWatch, Sentry (Spark work is ~5–10% — we don’t expect you to be a data engineer or own the data platform.) ## **What you’ll do** - Build and maintain backend services for experiment assignment, logging, and report generation - Improve scalability, performance, and reliability of experiment reporting pipelines - Add product-facing features to the UI to help users launch experiments and interpret results - Take technical ownership of projects: shape solutions, break down work, and drive execution with the team - Participate in a weekly on-call rotation (investigating occasional issues and answering internal questions) You’ll collaborate closely with Search/Recommendations engineers, ML/DS partners, and customer-facing teams when needed. This role does not require frequent direct customer calls. ## **Requirements** ### **Must-have** - Strong experience building and owning production backend services in Python - Experience with monitoring, alerting, and debugging user-facing systems - Strong SQL skills and confidence working with data-heavy systems (metrics, logging, analytics) - Ability to ship maintainable software (tests, code review, incremental delivery) ### **Mindset** - You take ownership: you can turn ambiguous problems into an executable technical plan - You care about building systems people trust and rely on ### **Nice-to-have** - Experience with experimentation systems, metrics platforms, or A/B testing workflows - Experience with PySpark and/or Databricks - We don’t expect you to already be an expert in experimentation methodology — but we do expect strong backend fundamentals and the ability to ramp up effectively in a data-heavy domain ### **Location / Time Zones** - We’re a distributed team. Preferred time zones are UTC+1 to UTC+7, but we’re flexible ## **Benefits** - 🏝️ Unlimited vacation time - we strongly encourage all employees to take at least 3 weeks per year - 🌎 Fully remote team - choose where you live - 🛋️ Work from home stipend - we want you to have the resources you need to set up your home office - 💻 Apple laptops provided for new employees - 🧑‍🎓 Training and development budget - refreshed each year for every employee - 👪 Maternity & Paternity leave for qualified employees - 🧠 Work with smart people who will help you grow and make a meaningful impact - 💵 Base salary: $80k–$110k USD, depending on knowledge, skills, experience, and interview results - 📈 Stock options - offered in addition to the base salary - 🎉 Regular team offsites to connect and collaborate ## **Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Constructor** At [Constructor.io](http://Constructor.io) we are committed to cultivating a work environment that is diverse, equitable, and inclusive. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome individuals of all backgrounds and provide equal opportunities to all applicants regardless of their education, diversity of opinion, race, color, religion, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status or affiliation in any other protected group. *Studies have shown that women and people of color may be less likely to apply for jobs unless they meet every one of the qualifications listed. Our primary interest is in finding the best candidate for the job. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of our listed qualifications.* **How we handle your data.** By submitting this application, you acknowledge that Constructor will collect and process the personal data you provide for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for this role. If you are not selected, we will retain your data for a limited period as described in our [Recruitment Privacy Notice](https://constructor.com/recruitment-privacy-notice). After that period your data will be deleted or anonymized.

Some of our present and future challenges include: Building systems around consumer IAM to meet the needs of Reddit’s engineering organization and millions of daily users. description: Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve. We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that. Here’s what this particular role covers. 🛠️ About our Data Enrichment Platform Team Our Enrichment Orchestration team builds the platform that enables Wayve’s teams to deploy, run, evaluate and continually improve machine-learning models. Processing petabytes of driving data across large GPU fleets, the team creates dependable, self-service capabilities that help model engineers understand model performance, improve quality and reduce operational effort and cost. 🧠 Your day-to-day Design, build and operate backend services, APIs and data-processing workflows for the Data Enrichment Platform. Develop model-execution workflows, versioned outputs, annotation capabilities and dataset-catalogue features. Improve the scalability and reliability of systems for large-scale inference, automated evaluation and model monitoring. Investigate and resolve reliability, performance and cost issues across petabyte-scale data and GPU-backed workloads. Contribute to designs covering data locality, scheduling, capacity, backpressure, failure recovery and observability. Collaborate with model engineering, AI Platform, infrastructure, compute, storage and data teams to deliver reusable capabilities. Write maintainable, tested and observable software while improving documentation, operational tooling and engineering standards. 🧩 What you’ll be working on A scalable platform for large-scale inference, automated evaluation, model monitoring, active learning and retraining. Backend services and APIs that allow model engineers to deploy and operate repeatable workflows independently. Reproducible dataset selection, versioned outputs, annotation workflows and dataset catalogues with clear metadata, provenance and lineage. Reliable model-execution workflows operating across petabytes of driving data and large GPU fleets. Monitoring and operational tooling that make platform reliability, throughput, cost and workflow status visible. The foundations for continuous evaluation, drift detection and automated model-improvement loops across robotics and computer-vision workloads. 🙌 You should apply if You have strong production software-engineering experience in Python, including building maintainable, tested and observable backend services, APIs or data-processing systems. You have experience designing, building or operating distributed systems for data-intensive or compute-intensive workloads. You have delivered reliable software from design through deployment and production operation. You have good system-design fundamentals and can make sound technical trade-offs within a complex platform. You are comfortable investigating unfamiliar systems and diagnosing reliability, performance or operational issues. You communicate clearly, collaborate effectively across teams and can take meaningful ownership of production components. Experience with Flyte, Airflow, Dagster, Argo, Spark, Databricks, Ray, Kubernetes, GPU infrastructure or ML-platform systems would be an advantage. Experience with production robotics or computer-vision platforms—including annotation, inference, evaluation and model monitoring—would be desirable, although computer-vision research expertise is not required. 🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. More about Wayve: 🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines. Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility. How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working: Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives. 🔍 The Interview Process Our process is clear and respectful of your time Initial call / Talent Partner screen (30 mins) Competency interviews : Python coding (60 mins), System design (60 mins) Deep Dive Interviews: SQL Domain (60 mins), Hiring Manager interview (45 mins ) Final interview : Mission, values and Staff-level calibration (45 mins) We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability. description: Monumental is automating on-site construction with robotics and software. Our mission is to make construction software-defined and autonomous - a future where beautiful, bespoke buildings go up in a single day, with minimal labour. We're a growing team of engineers, operators and technicians from companies like Palantir, Qualcomm, Dyson, Shopify, Tesla, Meta and Google DeepMind. It's still the early days of building the company, and this is a chance to make an outsized impact on a problem that matters. From day one, you’ll be working with an experienced founding team, backed by a $32M Series B led by Khosla Ventures and Plural. Monumental is based in the city centre of Amsterdam, in a beautiful facility with an fully equipped workshop and robot testing floor. We build the whole stack in-house - hardware and software, we're explicitly not a hybrid or remote-first company - you can't build robots or walls from home, so we're onsite five days a week. Read more on why we believe you should spend your time working on construction, and learn about [our vision](https://www.monumental.co/our-vision/) and [company](https://www.monumental.co/about/). You might enjoy our [YouTube Channel](https://www.youtube.com/@buildmonumental), [Based in Europe’s film on how we’re fixing Europe’s housing shortage](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2-Q2F0Fcx4A), or [this video by Andreas Klinger of what our office looks like](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DOo8n19XEns). **About the role** We're looking for a software engineer who wants to build full-stack software that can touch the physical world, not another SaaS product. You’ll develop and deploy software that controls fleets of autonomous construction robots. Full stack at Monumental is *really* full stack, covering everything from microcontroller firmware up to the web-based UI that operators use to control the robots. We’ve built CAD tools for designing masonry structures, path planning and motion control, telemetry and inspection tools, and distributed data storage and sync. The technical challenges we're solving combine hardware, software, and infrastructure at scale - while maintaining high availability on construction sites. [Atrium, our operating system for construction](https://www.monumental.co/atrium), is built with TypeScript and Rust. Much of our Rust code is compiled to WebAssembly, allowing our UI to interface directly with the same control code that we deploy to our robots. This gives us a shared stack between real-world deployments and simulated runs in the front-end. You can read about how we [control robots with TypeScript in this post by our CTO, Sebastiaan.](https://buildmonumental.substack.com/p/plans-as-data) As we're deploying more robots and software, we're always running into new challenges. The problems are often not straightforward: poor connectivity on a construction site because of interference, a memory leak that only becomes an issue after hours of runtime, a robot behaving differently than the simulation. This means a lot of creative problem solving is involved. One of our engineers even traced down a problem to a [memory leak in Chrome](https://bou.ke/blog/chromium-bug/), which got fixed soon after he submitted a bug report. To help us build, improve, and maintain our platform, we're looking for a strong generalist software engineer. You'll get a lot of autonomy and the chance to build software that builds actual robots and houses. You’ll also get the chance to collaborate with other engineering disciplines (e.g. electrical, mechanical) to support new robot features or debug issues. For more on how we think about the role, read Bouke’s post on [his experience joining Monumental as a software engineer](https://bou.ke/blog/robotics/). **What you'll do** Building telemetry that lets us see what every robot on site is doing in real time - so when something goes wrong, you know why Designing the core architecture of our platform, and choosing the right abstractions to map the messy world of construction into elegant software Prototyping components that talk to our robot's microcontrollers and distributed subsystems - shipping to production, onto a robot laying bricks within hours of writing the code Debugging complex issues that cut across the stack: e.g. bugs in the Chromium GC; WiFi connection issues with robot systems or race conditions in concurrent Rust code Writing Rust and TypeScript code that controls the robot in real-time, turning high-level goals into small steps that the robot can execute Working collaboratively with our team of hardware engineers, control engineers, and robot operators to improve product experience, reliability and performance of our platform **What we’re looking for** - Industry experience building and deploying production systems in multiple languages (Rust experience is valuable but not required) - You're probably the person everyone asks for help when an agent does something nobody can explain. You run them in parallel most of the time - to build, review code, catch security issues, draft incident reports. Not just vibe-coding prototypes. - Basic familiarity with Linux systems and conventions. E.g., you’re comfortable SSH’ing into other machines to figure out why something isn't working - Knowledge of common communication protocols, e.g. UDP, TCP/IP and WebSockets - A strong sense of ownership and motivation. You’re able to drive problems and projects start-to-finish without someone project managing you, and can thrive in a chaotic environment. - A high percentage of our software team have been a technical founder, CTO, or founding engineer before. If that’s your background, you’ll likely fit in. But we also get excited by people with a demonstrated background of shipping impressive work at any type of company. - Strong CS or mathematics foundation– you are a strong geometric thinker, understand basic linear algebra and 3D transformations **Why Monumental?** Joining Monumental means being at the forefront of a movement aimed at making significant strides in the construction industry. Here, your work has the potential to impact not just the company but the future of how we build. If you're driven by innovation, eager to tackle complex challenges, and ready to make a tangible difference, we want to hear from you. For open applications (where you don’t see an exact role match), please reach out to us at: iwanttojoin@monumental.co - share with us the most interesting or challenging project you’ve worked on, why you want to join and your CV or portfolio. Unfortunately we do not currently support internships. If you don’t meet all the qualifications here but are excited about Monumental and feel you’d still be able to help us solve difficult problems, do get in touch. We welcome generalists who focus on outcomes and are eager to learn on the job.

description: Estamos incorporando varias personas al equipo inicial de ingeniería. Buscamos perfiles con distintos recorridos que compartan una base técnica sólida, criterio de producto y ganas de asumir ownership real. El trabajo tiene un núcleo común. Durante el proceso ajustaremos el alcance inicial, la autonomía, la participación en arquitectura y estándares, y la compensación correspondiente. No necesitas encasillarte antes de aplicar: queremos entender qué has construido, dónde tienes mayor profundidad y qué responsabilidad estás preparado para asumir. Sobre la compañía NAIIAN es una startup Deep Tech europea, con financiación sólida y equipo fundador en Madrid. Construimos una plataforma SaaS B2G de data engineering e IA aplicada para clientes institucionales con alta exigencia operativa y decisional. Trabajamos con documentos, fuentes verificables, datos estructurados y no estructurados, permisos, workflows asistidos por IA, auditabilidad y aprobación humana. La IA no es una demo: debe apoyarse en datos fiables y ser útil, medible, auditable, segura y operable. Estamos formando la primera ola de ingeniería: perfiles generalistas, con una base sólida y al menos un área de profundidad, que trabajan directamente con el equipo fundador y participan en decisiones rápidas de producto y tecnología. Sobre el rol Construirás una plataforma SaaS B2G de extremo a extremo, con foco en data engineering e IA aplicada. Datos, agentes, backend, frontend y cloud deben funcionar como un sistema, no como silos. Puedes venir de backend, data engineering, IA aplicada, frontend, cloud o sistemas distribuidos. No buscamos que domines todo. Sí esperamos que entiendas el producto completo, puedas bajar al código donde haga falta y te muevas bien cuando los requisitos todavía son ambiguos. Puedes encajar si ya has tomado decisiones técnicas relevantes en producción y estás preparado para liderar áreas ambiguas, arquitectura o estándares. También si tienes autonomía creciente y estás preparado para asumir funcionalidades completas con acompañamiento. En ambos casos buscamos capacidad para construir, aprender y hacerse cargo del resultado con apoyo del equipo. El problema es concreto: ingerimos datos públicos oficiales de varios organismos, los normalizamos sobre una jerarquía territorial —país, estado, municipio— y construimos indicadores comparables, exploradores históricos y agentes que generan consultas validadas antes de ejecutarse. Alrededor existen workspaces, permisos, multi-tenancy, audit logs, trazabilidad de fuentes y control del coste de inferencia. En B2G, la calidad de datos, seguridad, explicabilidad y auditabilidad forman parte del producto. Trabajarás directamente con CTO, CPO y equipo fundador para convertir esta complejidad en un sistema robusto, comprensible y operable. Stack de referencia No esperamos dominio profundo de todo el stack. Como son varias incorporaciones, una persona podría centrarse inicialmente en ingesta y calidad de datos; otra, en funcionalidades que conecten backend, agentes e interfaz. Buscamos colaboración entre áreas, no especialización total. * Datos: PostgreSQL sobre Aurora Serverless v2, Liquibase, Python, S3, SQS y Lambda. * IA aplicada: Amazon Bedrock y AgentCore, LangChain y LangGraph. * Frontend: TypeScript, Next.js, TanStack Query, shadcn/ui, AI Elements, AG-UI, Orval, MapLibre y Recharts; Capacitor para Android e iOS. * Cloud: AWS —ECS Fargate, ALB, WAF, S3, SQS, Lambda, SES y Route 53— y Terraform. * Entrega y observabilidad: GitHub Actions con OIDC, OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch, X-Ray y Langfuse. * Testing: Playwright, JUnit con Testcontainers y ArchUnit, Vitest y pytest. Tu foco dependerá de tu área de profundidad y del producto. Estas son capacidades del equipo, no una lista que cada persona deba cubrir simultáneamente: * Construir capacidades de datos e IA listas para producción, desde modelos y procesamiento documental hasta agentes, APIs e interfaces. * Diseñar ingestas, datasets, evidencias, permisos, audit logs y workflows. * Integrar RAG, agentes, tool calling, structured outputs, guardrails, evals y trazabilidad. * Mejorar pipelines, búsqueda, calidad de datos y bases de conocimiento. * Crear contratos que conecten frontend, backend, datos, IA y cloud. * Implementar uploads, resultados parciales, errores recuperables, retries, cancelación y aprobación humana. * Desplegar y operar servicios con CI/CD, infraestructura reproducible, logs, métricas y control de costes. * Participar, cuando corresponda, en suscripción, cobro y ciclo de vida de cuenta con Stripe. * Experiencia construyendo software de producción: SaaS, plataformas B2B/B2G, sistemas data-heavy, pipelines o aplicaciones con IA. * Mentalidad generalista y profundidad real —o claramente en camino— en al menos un área técnica. * Buen criterio en APIs, modelos de datos, permisos, estados, errores, observabilidad y experiencia de usuario. * Código mantenible, testeable y preparado para producción. * Capacidad para entender problemas ambiguos, proponer soluciones, implementarlas y ajustarlas con feedback. * Sensibilidad por seguridad, privacidad, trazabilidad, auditabilidad y calidad operativa. * Pragmatismo para simplificar sin hipotecar el futuro del producto. * Experiencia o interés real en trabajar con Codex, Claude Code, Gemini o equivalentes mediante specs y revisión rigurosa. No establecemos un mínimo rígido de años. Nos importa más la complejidad de lo que hayas construido, tu contribución personal, las decisiones que hayas tomado y la responsabilidad que puedas asumir ahora. * Experiencia como early engineer, en equipos pequeños o construyendo productos de 0 a 1. * Productos con documentos, aprobaciones, auditoría, permisos, trazabilidad o datos sensibles. * Funcionalidades end-to-end que conecten datos, IA, backend, producto y operación. * LLMs, RAG, agentes, tool calling, structured outputs, evals o workflows de IA en producción.Multi-tenancy, rate limits, retries, idempotencia, observabilidad, fallbacks o controles de coste. * Decisiones de arquitectura u operación cuyos trade-offs puedas explicar. * Revisión técnica, documentación, mentoring o mejora de estándares. * Experiencia en B2G, SaaS, govtech, fintech, healthtech, legaltech, compliance, observability o data platforms. No necesitas cumplir todos los puntos. Queremos saber dónde tienes profundidad, qué has construido personalmente y en qué otras capas puedes aportar. Cómo trabajamos Somos un equipo fundador presencial en Madrid y con alta velocidad de decisión. Lo decimos claro porque es un filtro real: muchas decisiones se toman en horas y delante de una pizarra. Después quedan reflejadas en specs, código, pruebas y documentación para que puedan revisarse y evolucionar. Trabajamos con coding agents, documentación técnica viva y revisión rigurosa. Tendrás ownership sobre funcionalidades y decisiones concretas. Esperamos que crezcas con el equipo, te conviertas en referencia en tu área y contribuyas a los estándares y futuras incorporaciones. * Contrato indefinido a jornada completa, presencial en Madrid. * Salario ajustado al alcance, autonomía y experiencia demostrada. Compartiremos la banda aplicable antes de la primera entrevista. * Equity fundacional significativo, acorde al impacto y momento de entrada, con vesting estándar y condiciones transparentes durante el proceso. * Seguro médico privado y ticket restaurant dentro del plan de retribución flexible. * Setup premium: MacBook Pro, pantalla Dell de 40", periféricos a elección y silla Herman Miller o equivalente. * Ownership real sobre producto, arquitectura y funcionalidades completas, no solo tickets aislados. Cuatro conversaciones * Recursos Humanos: rol, compañía y expectativas. * Equipo fundador de ingeniería: cómo trabajas y qué has construido. * CTO: arquitectura, operación y trade-offs. * CEO: compañía, ambición y encaje mutuo. No hay prueba técnica ni ejercicio para casa. Hablaremos sobre nuestros problemas reales y sobre los que tú hayas resuelto. Durante el proceso acordaremos el alcance inicial, las áreas de ownership y la compensación correspondiente. #J-18808-Ljbffr

description: ## About Provable At Provable, our mission is to redefine trust and privacy in the digital world. By creating tools that simplify the complexities of zero-knowledge technology, we empower developers to build applications that prioritize security, user control and scalability. We envision a future where privacy is not an afterthought but a fundamental standard, enabling a more secure and equitable Web3. Our commitment extends beyond technology to fostering a vibrant, collaborative community of innovators. Through accessible resources, thoughtful design, and a focus on developer success, we aim to bridge the gap between cutting-edge blockchain technology and real-world applications. Together we’re not just building tools-we’re shaping the foundation for a private decentralized future. ## The Role Provable is searching for exceptional senior CUDA engineers to help build privacy preserving zero knowledge protocols and products. As a Provable senior engineer you will use your engineering talent to design, implement and maintain both cryptographic and distributed systems and help build privacy preserving products on top of those systems. Collaboration will be key. You should be able to work well with engineers, designers, and leadership to turn our products and technical vision into deliverables each quarter. description:
Job Title: Associate Data Engineer (Fresher)


Job Summary: We are seeking motivated freshers to join our team as Associate Data Engineers. This role offers an opportunity to build and maintain data pipelines, data warehouses and analytics platforms on the Microsoft data stack. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in SQL, a clear understanding of data warehouse and ETL concepts, and a keen interest in working with tools such as SQL Server, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Microsoft Fabric and Power BI.


Key Responsibilities:

Build, test and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Data Factory, SSIS or Microsoft Fabric Data Pipelines to ingest data from multiple source systems.

Develop and maintain data warehouse and lakehouse structures, including fact and dimension tables, star/snowflake schemas and staging layers.

Write, optimize and maintain SQL queries, views, stored procedures and transformation scripts.

Implement data quality checks, validation rules and error handling to ensure accurate and reliable data.

Monitor scheduled pipelines and jobs, troubleshoot failures and support performance tuning.

Prepare curated, analysis-ready datasets and semantic models for reporting in Power BI.

Work with data stored in Azure SQL Database, Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Synapse Analytics or Fabric OneLake.

Translate business and reporting requirements into data models and pipeline designs under the guidance of senior engineers.

Document data sources, data flows, data models and transformation logic.

Collaborate with data analysts, BI developers and business users to deliver data solutions on time.

Continuously learn and stay current with Microsoft data platform features and data engineering best practices.


Required Qualifications:

Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Mathematics or a related field (2025 / 2026 graduates eligible).

Strong working knowledge of SQL joins, subqueries, aggregations, window functions, CTEs, stored procedures and basic query optimization.

Understanding of data warehouse concepts OLTP vs OLAP, dimensional modeling, star and snowflake schemas, fact and dimension tables, slowly changing dimensions.

Understanding of ETL/ELT processes, data integration and incremental data loading.

Familiarity with the Microsoft data stack SQL Server and at least one of Azure Data Factory, SSIS, Azure Synapse Analytics or Microsoft Fabric.

Basic programming knowledge in Python (or PySpark) for data processing.

Hands on experience through academic projects, internships or self-learning in building a data pipeline or data warehouse.

Strong analytical, logical reasoning and problem solving skills.

Good verbal and written communication skills.

Eagerness to learn, attention to detail and the ability to work well in a team.


Preferred Qualifications:

Microsoft certifications such as DP-900 (Azure Data Fundamentals), DP-700 (Fabric Data Engineer Associate), DP-600 (Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate) or PL-300 (Power BI Data Analyst Associate).

Exposure to Apache Spark, Azure Databricks or Fabric notebooks.

Familiarity with Delta Lake and the medallion (bronze/silver/gold) architecture.

Basic knowledge of Power BI, DAX and Power Query for validating and consuming data models. Understanding of cloud fundamentals on Microsoft Azure (storage, compute, security and access control).

Familiarity with version control (Git), CI/CD concepts and Agile w

ays of working.

Academic projects, internships or portfolio work in data engineering, BI or data warehousing.

description: **Role Overview** We are looking for a Software Engineer who is genuinely strong at mathematics and enjoys turning that mathematics into working software. You will develop algorithms for gimbal and sensor calibration applications. The role covers the full path from mathematical model to deployed code, modelling, algorithm development, simulation, analysis, and a robust C/C++ implementation that holds up against real measurements. If you like problems where the answer has to be both mathematically correct and numerically well-behaved, this will suit you. **Key Responsibilities** • Design and implement mathematically intensive algorithms, with an emphasis on numerical accuracy and robustness. • Develop algorithms involving 2D and 3D geometry, coordinate transformations, rotation matrices and other rotation representations, camera parameters and sensor orientation. • Convert measurements between image, sensor, platform and world coordinate systems. • Process data from cameras, gimbals and multiple sensors, including data that is noisy, incomplete or asynchronous. • Handle timing and synchronization across subsystems - sensor latency, processing delays, clock differences and missing data. • Implement recursive estimation techniques that maintain a running best estimate of system state as successive noisy measurements arrive, including prediction between updates and handling of the associated uncertainty. • Apply filtering, smoothing and numerical methods - interpolation, integration, iterative solvers, least-squares fitting to produce stable results from imperfect input. • Analyze recorded datasets, evaluate algorithm accuracy against reference data, and quantify sources of error. • Build Python and Qt-based tooling for simulation, visualization and analysis to support algorithm development and validation. • Optimize algorithms for accuracy, robustness and real-time performance. • Work closely with the computer vision, imaging, embedded and systems teams. **Required Skills** **Mathematics** A strong working command of most of the following, and the ability to derive results rather than only apply library functions: • Linear algebra; vector and matrix mathematics • Trigonometry, 2D and 3D geometry • Coordinate transformations and rotation representations • Numerical methods and optimization • Error analysis and uncertainty estimation • Signal processing fundamentals Above all, you should be able to take a mathematical model and turn it into software that behaves correctly outside of ideal conditions. **Software Engineering** • Strong C/C++ programming skills, particularly in numerical or algorithm-heavy code. • Good working knowledge of Python for prototyping, simulation and data analysis. • Experience with Qt for building desktop tools, visualization utilities and operator-facing interfaces. • Comfortable working in a Linux development environment, with CMake, Git and standard build and debugging tooling. • Ability to write clean, maintainable and testable code. **Qualifications** A Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Mathematics, Applied Mathematics, Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, Control Systems or a related field. Demonstrated mathematical ability combined with solid software engineering experience matters more to us than the specific qualification.

If you enjoy solving complex problems, shaping products from the ground up, and influencing technical direction, Shipthis is the place for you. Learn more at www.shipthis.co **Role Overview** We are looking for an associate-level SecOps Engineer to support security operations, compliance, endpoint management, cloud infrastructure, and DevOps engineering. The role will work closely with the CTO/CISO and engineering team. Security and compliance are core responsibilities; when those priorities are lighter, the engineer will focus on CI/CD, infrastructure automation, reliability, monitoring, performance, and cloud cost optimization. **What You’ll be Doing** Security Operations * Monitor infrastructure, application, and security alerts and assist with incident investigation. * Review access controls, privileged accounts, service accounts, permissions, and periodic access reviews. * Support infrastructure hardening, logging, monitoring, backup, recovery, and other security controls. * Track security issues and corrective actions through closure. Vulnerability Management * Run and review application and infrastructure vulnerability scans. * Maintain a vulnerability register and coordinate remediation with engineering teams. * Support VAPT and penetration-testing exercises and validate closure of findings. * Monitor dependencies, containers, operating systems, and cloud infrastructure for known vulnerabilities and patching needs. Compliance & Governance * Support ongoing ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, customer-security, and internal-policy requirements. * Maintain audit evidence, control registers, security policies, procedures, risk items, and remediation records. * Assist with internal/external audits, vendor assessments, customer security questionnaires, and asset inventories. * Maintain evidence for access reviews, vulnerability management, incidents, onboarding/offboarding, backups, and infrastructure changes. MDM & Endpoint Security * Administer the company MDM platform and enroll/manage company laptops, desktops, and mobile devices. * Maintain device inventory and monitor endpoint compliance. * Enforce approved controls such as disk encryption, screen locks, password requirements, patching, and endpoint protection. * Support employee device onboarding/offboarding, approved application deployment, lost/stolen-device procedures, and remote wipe where authorized. * Maintain endpoint security and MDM evidence required for audits and troubleshoot enrollment or policy issues. DevOps, CI/CD & Cloud * Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines, deployment workflows, build times, caching, and rollback processes. * Support production and non-production cloud infrastructure, networking, DNS, TLS certificates, IAM, and secrets. * Automate repetitive deployment, infrastructure, security, and compliance tasks. * Improve monitoring, logging, alerting, reliability, resource utilization, and cloud costs. * Troubleshoot pipeline, deployment, and infrastructure issues and participate in root-cause analysis. **Required Fundamentals** * Basic knowledge of Linux, networking, HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, TLS, Git, Docker, cloud computing, APIs, and web applications. * Understanding of IAM, MFA, least privilege, vulnerabilities/CVEs, encryption, logging, patching, and secrets management. * Strong troubleshooting, ownership, attention to detail, and willingness to learn. **Desired Qualifications** * 1–2 years of experience with strong fundamentals are welcome. * Basic scripting knowledge in Python, Bash, or similar. * Interest in cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, automation, and troubleshooting. * Exposure to AWS/GCP/Azure, Terraform, GitHub Actions, Cloudflare, OWASP, vulnerability scanners, MDM, ISO 27001, or SOC 2 is a plus, not mandatory. **We Welcome Candidates:** * Who is immediate joining * Female candidates returning to work after a career break are strongly encouraged. **We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fostering diversity and inclusivity. description: Praetori builds sovereign AI software for European defence, intelligence, public security and critical-infrastructure organisations. We are looking for an engineer who will sit beside operators, understand their hardest problems, and turn them into software that holds under pressure. **About the role** This role sits at the seam between what our customers need and what Praetori builds. Requirements documents do not capture how mission-critical work actually happens. The truth lives in the operations room and the field, in the workarounds people have built around the gaps in their tools. Your job is to go there, see it, and close the gap in code. You deploy into a customer's environment, earn the trust of the people doing the work, and become the technical partner they call first. You prototype fast, ship into real operations, and carry what you learn back to the core product. **What you'll do** - Deploy on-site with defence, intelligence, public security and critical-infrastructure customers to understand their operations in depth. - Translate messy operational reality into clear problems, then into working software. - Prototype quickly against real workflows and data, iterating directly with the operators who will use it. - Ship production capabilities into live, high-consequence environments, and stand behind them. - Integrate with the customer's existing systems and constraints, including secure and offline environments. - Carry field insight back into the roadmap. Shape it with evidence, not opinion. **What you bring** - You can show software you shipped into real use, and explain the operational problem it solved. - Strong, versatile engineering ability. You build end to end and move fast through unfamiliar systems. - A record of shipping working software against ambiguous, fast-changing requirements. - Exceptional communication with non-engineers. - Comfort working on-site, travelling often (50%+), and operating in demanding environments. - Right to work in the EU and eligibility for security clearance. Fluent English. **Nice to have** - Experience in a forward deployed, solutions or field engineering role. - Background in defence, intelligence or critical infrastructure. - Familiarity with secure, air-gapped or edge deployments. - An additional European language. **Pay** EUR 60,000 to 100,000 gross per year, plus meaningful equity and a performance bonus. **Process** Three interviews: a 60 minute first interview, a 90 minute live technical session worked together (no take-home), and a conversation with the co-founders. Then references and EU security screening. Full description: https://www.praetori.ai/company/careers/founding-forward-deployed-engineer

description: Monumental is automating on-site construction with robotics and software. Our mission is to make construction software-defined and autonomous - a future where beautiful, bespoke buildings go up in a single day, with minimal labour. We're a growing team of engineers, operators and technicians from companies like Palantir, Qualcomm, Dyson, Shopify, Tesla, Meta and Google DeepMind. It's still the early days of building the company, and this is a chance to make an outsized impact on a problem that matters. From day one, you’ll be working with an experienced founding team, backed by a $32M Series B led by Khosla Ventures and Plural. Monumental is based in the city centre of Amsterdam, in a beautiful facility with an fully equipped workshop and robot testing floor. We build the whole stack in-house - hardware and software, we're explicitly not a hybrid or remote-first company - you can't build robots or walls from home, so we're onsite five days a week. Read more on why we believe you should spend your time working on construction, and learn about [our vision](https://www.monumental.co/our-vision/) and [company](https://www.monumental.co/about/). You might enjoy our [YouTube Channel](https://www.youtube.com/@buildmonumental), [Based in Europe’s film on how we’re fixing Europe’s housing shortage](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2-Q2F0Fcx4A), or [this video by Andreas Klinger of what our office looks like](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DOo8n19XEns). **About the role** We’re looking for engineers with deep knowledge of software and modern 3D computer vision. We’re building an operating system to make on-site construction possible with robotics. Our software stack allows us to do everything from 3D reconstruction of the construction site (through photogrammetry), design of custom wall structures, training and deploying vision algorithms, supply chain, path planning, and robot controls and kinematics. Some of the challenges we're solving with computer vision: - We make 3D reconstructions of construction sites that let us match the architect's (ideal) drawings to the real world. These reconstructions are made in challenging conditions - low or harsh light, limited space - by operators who aren't computer vision experts, and we need a fast turnaround so our robots can get building immediately. - Our robots place bricks and mortar with sub-millimetre accuracy in a global reference frame. These are higher accuracy requirements than autonomous driving, which means we ask more of our sensors - an off-the-shelf RealSense camera doesn't cut it. - Our robots aren't always on stable ground. Sometimes we build a canal wall from a boat, or work off a wobbly scaffold. That means compensating live, so we can still build a beautiful building. You can read about how we [control robots with TypeScript in this post by our CTO, Sebastiaan.](https://buildmonumental.substack.com/p/plans-as-data) If you're new to robotics, you might enjoy [reading Bouke's blog post on his experience joining Monumental as a software engineer](https://bou.ke/blog/robotics/). **What you'll do** - Developing algorithms for localisation, mapping, calibration, and state estimation using state-of-the-art techniques, allowing us to drive our autonomous vehicles in the ever-changing environment of a construction site. - Building the continuous localisation system for our robots, combining camera, depth, and IMU data to keep track of where the robot is at all times. - Designing and building vision systems that understand the construction site: spec the right cameras and sensors, train models that judge the quality of bricks and mortar, or recognise construction objects. - Implementing robust, production-level code that brings your algorithms to life. You own your projects from start to finish and don't approach problems like a researcher who hands a Jupyter notebook to a separate software engineering team. - Measuring the performance of our sensing system on a continuous basis, characterising the sources of error and performing root cause analysis - even when the robot is out on a construction site and you don't have direct physical access to it. **What we’re looking for** - Industry experience building and deploying 3D vision systems into production. - Deep understanding of, and hands-on experience with, multiple hardware sensor systems - LiDARs, IMUs, and (depth) cameras. - Experience developing, implementing, and testing mapping, localisation and state estimation algorithms such as (VI-)SLAM, VIO, ICP, and Kalman filters. - Ideally, some experience with real-time, deep-learning-based computer vision - e.g. multi-object tracking systems. - Proven software engineering experience in C, C++, Python, Rust, or comparable languages - beyond doing things in a Jupyter notebook. - Software engineering best practices: git for version control, unit testing, automated deployment. - A strong bias for action and output. We're not a research organisation - we ship frequently and iterate fast. - A strong sense of ownership and motivation. **Why Monumental?** Joining Monumental means being at the forefront of a movement aimed at making significant strides in the construction industry. Here, your work has the potential to impact not just the company but the future of how we build. If you're driven by innovation, eager to tackle complex challenges, and ready to make a tangible difference, we want to hear from you. For open applications (where you don’t see an exact role match), please reach out to us at: iwanttojoin@monumental.co - share with us the most interesting or challenging project you’ve worked on, why you want to join and your CV or portfolio. Unfortunately we do not currently support internships. If you don’t meet all the qualifications here but are excited about Monumental and feel you’d still be able to help us solve difficult problems, do get in touch. We welcome generalists who focus on outcomes and are eager to learn on the job.

description: About Dancify Dancify is a mobile-first festival platform for the global social dance community. The platform helps dancers discover events, connect with verified attendees, and organize their festival experience. Current stage: • Pre-launch MVP build • 540+ waitlist signups • 11K+ Instagram audience • Pilot festivals in Amsterdam This is the MVP build phase targeting the first pilot festival release within 13 weeks. --- The Role You will build Dancify’s production mobile application in React Native using Expo for iOS and Android while collaborating closely with the backend developer. The approved prototype and user flows will be provided as the UX, content, interaction, and permissions reference. The prototype itself is not the production application repository. You will integrate the mobile application with a versioned Node.js/PostgreSQL backend hosted on Google Cloud. Compensation is equity-first and milestone-based. The role also includes a predefined deferred settlement cap of up to €6,000 EUR that may optionally be used in the future if the company secures funding or operating revenue. Any future settlement remains entirely at company discretion and would only apply in exchange for reducing or repurchasing some portion of vested equity. Contractors are not co-founders and do not receive governance or voting rights. --- What You Will Build 1. React Native / Expo application foundation for iOS and Android 2. Browse-first guest experience for public festival discovery 3. Contextual account gates that return users to the action they originally attempted 4. Account type, Firebase SMS phone verification, legal consent, and session restoration 5. Progressive profile setup for profile details, photo, dance styles, level, role, languages, and location 6. Event discovery, filtering, event details, festival previews, pass selection, and pricing 7. External ticket-purchase handoff through an in-app browser 8. Ticket upload, verification states, ticket wallet, QR display, and event-scoped access 9. Matching deck/list, attendee profiles, filters, Pass / Yes / Dance Spark interactions 10. Connection requests, inbox, connection list, and push-notification navigation 11. Festival Hub with schedule, line-up, venues, announcements, and public preview states 12. Planner, My Day, saved/attending sessions, and schedule-conflict warnings 13. Coordination tools for rides, roommates, stays, and meetups 14. Organizer event, schedule, announcement, insight, and staff-role views 15. QR ticket scanner and check-in flows for authorized festival staff 16. Ticket-verification exception and moderation queues 17. Report, block, privacy, data-export, and account-deletion flows 18. Expo Push Service registration and notification handling 19. Deep linking, route guards, offline-safe ticket display, empty/error/loading states, and network resilience 20. TestFlight and Google Play closed-testing delivery --- Milestones and Equity Schedule M1: Foundation Weeks 1-3 Equity: 0.375% Deliverables: Expo/TypeScript foundation, navigation and state/query layer, Splash/Welcome, public discovery shell, contextual account gates, account type, SMS OTP, legal consent, Setup Complete, progressive profile screens, secure token/session handling, deep-link hydration, push registration and safe route guards. M2: Events & Tickets Weeks 4-6 Equity: 0.270% Deliverables: Event discovery and filters, event detail, Festival Hub preview, pass/pricing UI, external purchase handoff, upload/verify-ticket states, ticket wallet and QR, organizer event creation and management. M3: Matching & Connections Weeks 6-8 Equity: 0.300% Deliverables: Matching deck/list, filters, attendee profile cards, Pass/Yes/Dance Spark interactions, first-use profile completion, request inbox, accept/decline, connections list, push handling and deep-link navigation. M4: Festival Hub & Planner Weeks 8-11 Equity: 0.405% Deliverables: Public Hub preview, verified-attendee Hub, schedule/day/room filters, line-up, venues/map handoff, announcements, session details, My Planner, My Day, conflicts, coordination tools, organizer schedule/announcement UI and insights dashboard. M5: Staff, Safety & Launch Weeks 11-13 Equity: 0.150% Deliverables: Staff-role UI, ticket QR scanner/check-in states, ticket exception queue, moderation queue, report/block/privacy controls, data export/deletion request flows, performance and accessibility work, network/offline/error states, TestFlight and Play closed-testing builds, end-to-end QA. TOTAL Full mobile MVP 13 weeks 1.500% equity --- Important Product Rules • Guests can browse approved public content before signup. • OTP is SMS only through Firebase. • Profile completion is progressive rather than blocking initial signup. • There is no free Confirm Going action that unlocks attendee functionality. • Attendee access is granted only after an approved ticket purchase or verification path. • Ticket access is event-specific. • A ticket for one festival cannot unlock another festival. • Matching is available to eligible signed-in dancers and does not require a festival ticket. • Direct messaging and festival/workshop chat are not part of the MVP. • Native Stripe checkout is not part of the baseline. • Production schedules come from the backend and must not be hard-coded from prototype data. --- Requirements 1. 3+ years building production React Native apps 2. Strong TypeScript experience 3. Strong React Navigation or equivalent production navigation experience 4. At least 2 published iOS/Android applications 5. Strong experience with the Expo ecosystem and EAS builds 6. Experience with Expo push notifications and deep-link navigation 7. Experience integrating authenticated REST APIs and handling server-side permission states 8. Experience with secure session/token storage 9. Comfortable implementing approved designs and flows precisely 10. Experience with camera/QR scanning and native device capabilities is strongly preferred 11. Experience handling offline/network/error states in production mobile applications 12. Self-directed and milestone-driven 13. Strong written English 14. Available for one weekly sync call --- Strong Plus Experience with: • Firebase Phone Authentication • Expo Notifications • Expo Camera / QR scanning • EAS Build and Submit • App Store Connect / TestFlight • Google Play closed testing • React Query / TanStack Query or equivalent • Ticketing or festival applications • Deep linking and protected navigation • Offline-safe mobile state --- Intellectual Property & Ownership All work produced under this agreement, including code, technical systems, assets, implementations, and documentation, becomes the exclusive intellectual property of Dancify upon creation and milestone approval. Contractors are not co-founders and do not receive governance rights, voting rights, or executive authority through equity compensation unless separately agreed in writing. --- Application Send: 1. description: We're hiring 4–5 Senior Software Engineers (Biologic Discovery) in Bilbao, Spain. On-site. Visa + relocation sponsorship. MiXCR is the standard for immune analysis, cited in thousands of papers and patents. Platforma is the OS we're building on top of it — turning bioinformatics into self-serve, interoperable "blocks" for real biologic discovery. 5 of the top 10 pharma run discovery programs with Platforma today. Our goal is 10 of 10 by year-end. Our tools are in the published methods of approved cancer immunotherapies and the vaccines that reached millions of people. The next paper that cites us could be the next drug. We've merged our desktop, bioinformatics, and data teams into one. AI made cross-domain context cheap; the silo wall is gone. Bioinformaticians who leaned into engineering, and engineers who leaned into biology, now ship at multiples of what they used to. We need more of those. WHAT YOU'D BUILD – Discovery pipelines: raw sequences → pre-IND leads. Therapeutic antibodies, biomarkers, end-to-end workflows real scientists use. – The Platforma SDK that computational biologists love: TypeScript, Vue, Tengo (a niche Lua-like workflow DSL — yes, you'll learn it), Rust. Open Source. – The data layer: thousands of bioinformatics formats reduced to one common denominator. PFrames, Parquet, DataFusion, lazy columnar everything. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR – Strong TypeScript in 100k-line monorepos; Polars > pandas. – Either prior bioinformatics exposure, or a serious appetite to learn it in your first month. We can teach VDJ recombination; we can't teach curiosity. – Tolerance for sparse docs and niche DSLs. "Fix the SDK, don't work around it" instinct. NOT A FIT – Pure frontend/backend/bioinformatics with no crossover appetite. – "I'll just rewrite the abstraction before I understand it." – You want to stay strictly in TypeScript-land or strictly in bioinformatics-land. The role is the bridge. THE OFFER – €90–120k base, real ESOP, ARR-tied bonus — when we grow, you grow, in cash, this year, not "someday." – Bizkaia Special Impatriate Regime: ~15–20% effective tax. Net beats London, Berlin, Amsterdam. – Visa, relocation, soft-landing package. – No HR, no take-homes. You talk directly to engineering and to me. – Bilbao: ocean, mountains, Michelin restaurants, low cost of living, highest quality of life. On-site — cross-domain context-sharing genuinely doesn't work over Zoom. Or email me directly: stanp (at) milaboratories.com — subject "Wellfound", include your GitHub. I read every one and reply personally. Tell me about a scientific CLI you wrapped, a plugin SDK you built, or a Polars query that survived 50M rows.

With a simple shortcut, users can instantly summarize, translate, rewrite, proofread, understand copied text, organize notes, and process information without breaking their workflow. Unlike long-running autonomous AI agents, IrukaDark is designed as a “Super-Sub AI”: fast, lightweight, always close to the user, and focused on helping people think, read, write, and work faster in the moment. We are now expanding IrukaDark globally and are looking for an early engineer to help us build a fast, practical, and delightful desktop AI product. **About the Role** We are looking for a hands-on software engineer who can help build and improve IrukaDark across desktop app development, AI integration, user experience, performance, and product quality. This is an early-stage role. You will work closely with the founding team and have a direct impact on the product, technical decisions, and user experience. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building fast user-facing products, working with AI APIs, improving UX details, and shipping quickly. This is intended for those who have experience using IrukaDark as a user. Without the user's perspective, it is impossible to develop excellent UX. **Responsibilities** ・Build and improve the IrukaDark desktop application ・Develop features for summarization, translation, rewriting, proofreading, task handling, note organization, and AI-assisted workflows ・Integrate AI models and APIs into the product ・Improve app speed, reliability, and usability ・Design smooth shortcut-based workflows for daily PC tasks ・Fix bugs, improve edge cases, and polish the user experience ・Work with the team to turn user feedback into product improvements ・Help define the technical direction of an early-stage AI product **Requirements** ・Experience building software products with TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, or similar languages ・Experience with frontend or desktop application development ・Interest in AI tools, productivity software, and human-computer interaction ・Ability to build quickly, test ideas, and improve based on feedback ・Strong problem-solving skills and attention to user experience ・Comfortable working remotely and independently ・Ability to communicate clearly in English **Nice to Have** ・Experience with Electron, Tauri, Swift, Windows app development, or macOS app development ・Experience integrating LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or other AI models ・Experience building productivity tools, browser extensions, developer tools, or desktop utilities ・Experience with performance optimization ・Experience designing keyboard shortcuts, clipboard workflows, or system-level utilities ・Interest in UX, product design, or growth **Tech Stack** Our current and future stack may include: ・TypeScript / JavaScript ・Desktop app frameworks such as Electron or Tauri ・AI APIs and LLM integrations ・Web frontend technologies ・Backend APIs ・Cloud services ・macOS and Windows desktop environments You do not need to know everything in advance. We care more about your ability to learn quickly, build practical features, and improve the product for real users. **Why Join Us** ・Build a global AI product from Japan ・Work directly with the founder and product team ・Take ownership of core product features ・Work on a product where speed, UX, and practical AI usage matter deeply ・Flexible remote work ・Opportunity to grow into a founding engineer or technical lead role ・Help define a new category of desktop AI assistant

description: 📍 **Berlin, On-site** · Full-time 🏦 €70,000-€90,000 + equity ⏰ Full-time ## TL;DR Kombo (YC S22) is building a unified API that saves engineering teams hundreds of hours by integrating dozens of HRIS, ATS, and Payroll systems into one API. We're looking for a **Technical Support Engineer** to provide exceptional technical assistance to our rapidly growing customer base, debug complex integration issues, and help shape the foundation of our support function. You’ll be the technical bridge between our customers and our product / engineering teams. ## About Kombo Kombo is building the unified API for HR, payroll, and recruiting systems. Instead of companies spending months integrating with dozens of different systems, they can integrate once with Kombo and instantly connect to over 160 platforms. We abstract away the complexity of handling different data schemas, authentication methods, and API quirks. **Since going through Y Combinator in 2022, we’ve:** - Raised $30M+ of funding from Y Combinator, Acadian Ventures, 468 and other investors - Grew from 0→ $XXM ARR and hundreds of customers (growth-wise among the ~top-5% of VC-backed startups) - Scaled to process data for the equivalent of 10% of Germany's workforce - Grew to a team of 80+ team members ([pictures](https://www.notion.so/Join-Kombo-05435d42f09a4b85b2083ae2266543af?pvs=21)!) in 2x offices Kombo is an international company by default. We operate across two main hubs (NYC 🇺🇸 and Berlin 🇩🇪) and work with a globally distributed team representing **20+ nationalities**. ## Why Support at Kombo Matters At Kombo we care A LOT about excellent support for our customers to a degree that is unusual. We do so because fundamentally we view excellent support as a competitive advantage. How this looks like in practice is that - we win [G2 badges](https://www.g2.com/products/kombo/reviews) for best support in our category - we get customer love for our support weekly and even frequently hear that our support is the best that our customers *ever* experienced (across all products they have used) - “Support quality” is one of the top 3 reasons companies choose Kombo As we scale our presence in the US market, our current setup (support team rotating to the NYC office) is reaching its limits. To maintain our standard, we’re extending our existing team into the US and Germany. ## What You’ll Be Working On In this role, you’ll act as a **support engineer, not a support agent** — solving most issues directly and collaborating with our engineering team on more complex ones. ### Day-to-day: - **Troubleshooting & Debugging:** Investigate API integrations, data-sync issues, authentication flows (OAuth, API keys), and provider-specific edge cases. - **Customer Guidance:** Assist customer engineers via Slack, email & occasional video calls — clear, concise, and technical. - **Internal Collaboration:** Work closely with Product & Engineering to escalate bugs, relay feedback, and shape fix priorities. - **Knowledge Building:** Create and maintain internal / external docs and guides based on recurring topics. - **Process Improvement:** Set up better tooling, automation, and reporting to scale our support capabilities. ### Example projects: - Debugging why new hires aren’t syncing correctly from a customer’s ATS (via Kombo) and fixing a mapping edge case. - Helping a customer engineer resolve an OAuth 2.0 connection flow issue. - Spotting a commonly misunderstood API parameter and collaborating with Engineering to improve docs or design. - Building dashboards or alerts to proactively monitor integration health. - Implement smaller new features across the codebase based on your findings **Tech you’ll work with:** APIs (REST + SOAP + OAuth), Node.js, TypeScript, SQL, GCP (logs & monitoring), and various HRIS / ATS / Payroll systems + Kombo’s own troubleshooting tools. ## Who We’re Looking For You’re a technically adept problem-solver with strong communication skills and a builder’s mindset. You might be a great fit if you: - Have a solid technical background (Software Engineer, Support Engineer, Solutions Engineer, etc.) and enjoy debugging APIs & integrations - **You can navigate large, unfamiliar codebases.** You're comfortable digging into code you didn't write and don't yet fully understand, tracing data flows and logic across a large production codebase to find the root cause. - **You can write production code.** You've shipped code to production before — whether as a software engineer, by building production-ready products, or by debugging and shipping fixes to live systems. Ideally in TypeScript / JavaScript, but strong experience in another modern language (e.g., Go, Python) works too. - Communicate clearly and can explain technical concepts to engineers and non-engineers alike - Are empathetic and patient — you enjoy helping others solve problems - Thrive with autonomy, take initiative, and drive your own projects - Like structured, high-performance environments and prefer working in person (we’re an in-office culture) Prior experience in a technical support role is a plus but not required. ## What It’s Like to Work at Kombo Our culture balances high ambition with a fun, supportive environment. A few things that define us: - 🚀 Our growth puts us in the top 5 % of VC-backed companies and we plan to keep that pace - 🧠 We keep teams small and high-performing (similar to Netflix or Ashby) - ✍️ We use long-form docs to make key decisions — clarity \> meetings - 🎉 We celebrate weekly — big launches, closings, or birthdays - 😂 Our Engineering Meme culture is legendary internally ## Closing If joining an “SF-style company in Berlin” sounds appealing, you should apply — even if you don’t tick every box 🙂 We’re excited to meet you!
